modules.App:
--[[
	App — the ZAAL Assets panel.

	Left: every skin in this place, grouped by slot, with its status, tier and shop
	state; search and filters. Right: the selected skin — a 3D thumbnail, what it
	needs before the shop, Preview on the ship, Setup (face / light / name text),
	Tier (website + game), the checks, what Approve would change, and Approve.

	Nothing runs per frame. Live hooks: Selection.SelectionChanged while the panel
	is open, and the preview's model watch while a skin is being previewed.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local ShipSkins = require(script.Parent.ShipSkins)
local ToolSkins = require(script.Parent.ToolSkins)
local Website = require(script.Parent.Website)
local Preview = require(script.Parent.Preview)
local Setup = require(script.Parent.Setup)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)
local PreviewTab = require(script.Parent.PreviewTab)
local Review = require(script.Parent.Review)

local LOGO = "rbxassetid://92946926368629" -- the game's wheel-face symbol (docs/notes/tooling/brand-assets.md)

local new, T, col = Theme.new, Theme.text, Theme.color

local App = {}

local state = {
	mode = nil, -- "ship" | "tool"
	skins = {},
	results = {},
	selected = nil,
	filter = "all",
	query = "",
	collapsed = {}, -- [slot] = true
	previewing = nil, -- the skin shown on the preview ship
	previewItem = 1,
	showRow = false,
	busy = false,
}
local ui = {}

local STATE_LABEL = { new = "NEW", same = "IN SHOP", changed = "CHANGED" }
local STATE_COLOR = { new = col.accent, same = col.ok, changed = col.warn }

local function module() return state.mode == "tool" and ToolSkins or ShipSkins end

local function worst(r)
	local lvl = "ok"
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then return "bad" end
		if c.level == "warn" then lvl = "warn" end
	end
	return lvl
end

local function toast(text, level)
	if not ui.status then return end
	ui.status.Text = text
	ui.statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = level and col[level] or col.info
end

local function expectedItemId(skin)
	return (skin.kind == "tool" and "Tool:" or "Ship:") .. skin.slot .. ":" .. skin.key
end

local function tierOf(skin, r)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	if web and web.tier then return Slots.TIERS[web.tier] end
	if skin.kind == "tool" then return r and r.want and r.want.Tier end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local e = cat and cat[skin.slot] and cat[skin.slot][skin.key]
	return e and e.tier
end

local function inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local r = module().inspect(skin, web or nil)
	state.results[skin] = r
	return r
end

local renderList, renderDetail
local renderBodyList, renderBodyDetail -- the Body colours tab (defined further down)

-- LIST --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function matches(skin)
	local q = state.query:lower()
	if q ~= "" and not skin.key:lower():find(q, 1, true) and not skin.slot:lower():find(q, 1, true) then return false end
	local r = state.results[skin]
	if not r then return true end
	if state.filter == "new" then return r.status == "new" end
	if state.filter == "changed" then return r.status == "changed" end
	if state.filter == "problems" then return worst(r) == "bad" end
	if state.filter == "review" then return Review.get(skin.model) ~= nil end
	return true
end

renderList = function()
	-- the filter chips mean nothing on the Preview tab
	if ui.filters then ui.filters.Visible = state.mode ~= "preview" end
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyList() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderList() end
	local list = ui.list
	for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIListLayout") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local counts = { all = #state.skins, new = 0, changed = 0, problems = 0, review = 0 }
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if Review.get(s.model) then counts.review += 1 end
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
		local r = state.results[s]
		if r then
			if r.status == "new" then counts.new += 1 end
			if r.status == "changed" then counts.changed += 1 end
			if worst(r) == "bad" then counts.problems += 1 end
		end
	end
	for key, b in pairs(ui.filterButtons) do
		b.Text = ({ all = "All", new = "New", changed = "Changed", problems = "Problems", review = "Review" })[key] .. "  " .. counts[key]
	end

	local order = 0
	local groups, groupOrder = {}, {}
	for _, skin in ipairs(state.skins) do
		if matches(skin) then
			if not groups[skin.slot] then
				groups[skin.slot] = {}
				table.insert(groupOrder, skin.slot)
			end
			table.insert(groups[skin.slot], skin)
		end
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(groupOrder) do
		order += 1
		local collapsed = state.collapsed[slot]
		local head = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), LayoutOrder = order }, {
			T((collapsed and "+  " or "–  ") .. slot:upper(), { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0) }),
			T(tostring(#groups[slot]), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col.dim,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }),
		})
		head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.collapsed[slot] = not state.collapsed[slot] or nil
			renderList()
		end)
		head.Parent = list
		if not collapsed then
			for _, skin in ipairs(groups[slot]) do
				order += 1
				local r = state.results[skin]
				local sel = state.selected == skin
				local lvl = r and worst(r) or "info"
				local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
				local row = new("TextButton", {
					Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = order,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.bg,
					BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1,
				}, {
					Theme.corner(6),
					new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -4),
						BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl] or col.info, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(4) }),
					T(skin.key, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }),
				})
				local chips = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X },
					{ Theme.hlist(4) })
				local hl = chips:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
				hl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
				if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then
					Theme.pill(tier:sub(1, 1), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 1, Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }).Parent = chips
				end
				if Review.get(skin.model) then
					Theme.pill("REVIEW", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 0 }).Parent = chips
				end
				if r then
					Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = chips
				end
				chips.Parent = row
				row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 0 row.BackgroundColor3 = col.hover end end)
				row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if state.selected ~= skin then row.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end end)
				row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					state.selected = skin
					state.showRow = false
					renderList()
					renderDetail()
				end)
				row.Parent = list
			end
		end
	end
	if order == 0 then
		T(state.mode and "No skins match." or "Open the Assets place (ship skins) or PVP&NPC ASSETS (tool skins).",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = list
	end
end

-- DETAIL ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function thumbnail(model)
	local vf = new("ViewportFrame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 112), BackgroundColor3 = col.raised,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -0.5), Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 175) },
		{ Theme.corner(10) })
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local copy = model:Clone()
		for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Light") then d:Destroy() end
		end
		if copy:IsA("BasePart") then
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			copy.Parent = m
			copy = m
		end
		copy.Parent = vf
		local cf, size = copy:GetBoundingBox()
		local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
		cam.FieldOfView = 30
		local dist = size.Magnitude * 1.9
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + (cf.LookVector * -1 + cf.RightVector * 0.7 + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)).Unit * dist, cf.Position)
		cam.Parent = vf
		vf.CurrentCamera = cam
	end)
	if not ok then T("no preview", { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = vf end
	return vf
end

local function checkLine(c, order, skin)
	local mark = ({ ok = "✓", warn = "!", bad = "✕", info = "•" })[c.level]
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = order })
	new("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20), BackgroundColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
		BorderSizePixel = 0 }, { Theme.corner(10),
		T(mark, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = col[c.level] or col.info, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center }) }).Parent = f
	T(c.text, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, c.fix and -230 or -30, 0, 0),
		TextColor3 = c.level == "info" and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = f
	if c.fix then
		local b = Theme.button(c.fix.label, "secondary", function()
			local ok, err = ShipSkins.runFix(c.fix)
			toast(ok and (c.fix.label .. " — done (Ctrl+Z undoes it).") or ("Fix failed: " .. tostring(err)), ok and "ok" or "bad")
			inspectOne(skin)
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
		end, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0, -2), Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 26), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, TextSize = 12,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd })
		b.Parent = f
	end
	return f
end

local function refreshSkin(skin)
	inspectOne(skin)
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
end

-- the skin's theme: its first tag that is not a colour-group or tool tag
local function themeOf(skin)
	if skin.kind == "ship" then return ShipSkins.themeOf(skin) end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(skin.model)) do
		if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" and not t:match("Skin$") then return t end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the body in the skin's theme colours (or back to default)
local function paintBody(skin)
	local theme = themeOf(skin)
	if state.bodyPaint == false or not theme then
		Preview.paint(nil)
		state.paintSource = state.bodyPaint == false and "Default body colours." or "No theme tag, so the body keeps its default colours."
		return
	end
	local palette, source = Preview.paletteFor(theme, ShipSkins.catalogData())
	Preview.paint(palette)
	state.paintSource = palette and ("Body painted with " .. source .. ".")
		or (source or ("No body colours found for " .. theme .. " — no catalogue paint rows and no colour donor in workspace.ship tagged " .. theme .. "."))
end

local function showPreview(skin, r)
	if skin.kind ~= "ship" then return end
	-- a clean ship: only this skin, defaults in every other slot. Without this, pieces left by
	-- an earlier preview (another theme's set from the Preview tab) stayed on the other slots.
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local ok, why = Preview.show(skin, r.plan)
	if not ok then
		toast("Preview: " .. tostring(why), "bad")
		return
	end
	paintBody(skin)
	state.previewing = skin
	Preview.watch({ skin.model }, function()
		if state.previewing ~= skin or not skin.model.Parent then return end
		local nr = inspectOne(skin)
		Preview.show(skin, nr.plan)
		if state.selected == skin then renderDetail() end
	end)
end

local function stopPreview()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	state.previewing = nil
end

renderDetail = function()
	if state.mode == "body" then return renderBodyDetail() end
	if state.mode == "preview" then return PreviewTab.renderDetail() end
	local d = ui.detail
	for _, c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
		if not (c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIPadding")) then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local skin = state.selected
	if not skin then
		local empty = Theme.card(nil, 1)
		T("Pick a skin on the left — or select its model in the Explorer.", { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextSize = 16, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = empty
		T("Every skin is checked for its type. Preview shows it on the ship exactly where the game puts it; Setup adds a face, light or name text; Tier changes the website and the game price; Approve adds it to the shop Packages.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = empty
		empty.Parent = d
		return
	end
	local r = state.results[skin] or inspectOne(skin)
	local web = Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot)
	local tier = tierOf(skin, r)
	local isShip = skin.kind == "ship"

	-- HERO
	local hero = Theme.card(nil, 1)
	local top = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 112), LayoutOrder = 1 })
	thumbnail(skin.model).Parent = top
	local info = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -128, 1, 0) }, { Theme.vlist(6) })
	T(skin.key, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 22, LayoutOrder = 1, TextWrapped = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28) }).Parent = info
	local tags = ShipSkins.themeTags(skin.model)
	local shownTheme = themeOf(skin)
	local themeText = shownTheme and ("  ·  theme " .. shownTheme) or ""
	if isShip and shownTheme and not table.find(tags, shownTheme) then
		themeText ..= #tags > 0 and ("  (tagged " .. table.concat(tags, ", ") .. ")") or "  (no tag)"
	end
	T(skin.slot .. (isShip and "  ·  ship skin" or "  ·  tool skin") .. themeText,
		{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = info
	local pills = Theme.row(6, 3, 22)
	Theme.pill(STATE_LABEL[r.status], STATE_COLOR[r.status], { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pills
	if tier and Theme.TIER[tier] then Theme.pill(tier:upper(), Theme.TIER[tier], { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pills end
	if web == false then
		Theme.pill("NOT ON WEBSITE", col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
	elseif web then
		Theme.pill(web.status == "approved" and "WEBSITE APPROVED" or ("WEBSITE " .. tostring(web.status):upper()),
			web.status == "approved" and col.ok or col.warn, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pills
		if web.exclusive then Theme.pill("EXCLUSIVE", Theme.TIER.Legendary, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pills end
	end
	pills.Parent = info
	local actions = Theme.row(8, 4, 32)
	if isShip then
		Theme.button(state.previewing == skin and "Refresh preview" or "Preview on ship", "secondary", function()
			showPreview(skin, r)
			state.previewItem = 1
			Preview.focus(skin.slot, 1)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = actions
	end
	Theme.button("Select", "ghost", function() Selection:Set({ skin.model }) end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = actions
	local owner = Review.isOwner()
	local pending = Review.get(skin.model)
	local ab, aapi
	if owner then
		local approveText = r.status == "new" and "Approve — add to shop" or (r.status == "changed" and "Approve — update shop"
			or (pending and "Mark reviewed ✓" or "Approved ✓"))
		ab, aapi = Theme.button(approveText, "primary", function()
			if state.busy then return end
			state.busy = true
			toast("Writing " .. skin.key .. " into the shop…")
			local ok, msg = module().approve(skin, r)
			state.busy = false
			if ok then Review.clear(skin.model) end
			toast(msg, ok and "ok" or "bad")
			if ok then refreshSkin(skin) end
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(r.ok and (r.status ~= "same" or pending ~= nil))
	else
		-- DESIGNER: the shop is the owner's; ask for it
		ab, aapi = Theme.button(pending and "Sent for review ✓" or "Send for review", "primary", function()
			local ok = Review.mark(skin.model, state.reviewNote or "")
			state.reviewNote = nil
			toast(ok and (skin.key .. " sent to the owner for review.") or "Could not mark it.", ok and "ok" or "bad")
			refreshSkin(skin)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 3 })
		aapi.setEnabled(r.ok and pending == nil)
	end
	ab.Parent = actions
	actions.Parent = info
	info.Parent = top
	top.Parent = hero
	hero.Parent = d

	-- READINESS
	local bad, warn = {}, 0
	for _, c in ipairs(r.checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then table.insert(bad, c.text) elseif c.level == "warn" then warn += 1 end
	end
	local lvl = #bad > 0 and "bad" or (warn > 0 and "warn" or "ok")
	local headline = #bad > 0 and (#bad == 1 and "1 thing to fix before it can go in the shop" or (#bad .. " things to fix before it can go in the shop"))
		or (r.status == "same" and "In the shop and up to date" or (warn > 0 and ("Ready for the shop — " .. warn .. " note" .. (warn > 1 and "s" or "") .. " below") or "Ready for the shop"))
	if web == false and #bad == 0 then headline ..= "  ·  hidden until the website sells it" end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(col[lvl], 1), Theme.pad(10, 14, 10, 14), Theme.vlist(4) })
	banner:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Transparency = 0.5
	T(headline, { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = col[lvl], LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = banner
	for i, b in ipairs(bad) do
		if i <= 3 then T("•  " .. b, { TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 1 + i }).Parent = banner end
	end
	banner.Parent = d

	-- REVIEW
	if pending or not owner then
		local rc = Theme.card(owner and "Review requested" or "Review", 2.5)
		if pending then
			T(Review.text(pending), { FontFace = Theme.fontMedium, TextColor3 = col.warn, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			Theme.button(owner and "Clear the request" or "Withdraw", "ghost", function()
				Review.clear(skin.model)
				refreshSkin(skin)
			end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = rc
		else
			T("Designer mode: adjust, preview and set up freely — the owner approves what goes live. Add a note, then Send for review.",
				{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = rc
			local box = Theme.input("Note for the owner (optional) — what changed, what to check", state.reviewNote or "", { LayoutOrder = 2 })
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() state.reviewNote = box.Text end)
			box.Parent = rc
		end
		rc.Parent = d
	end

	-- PREVIEW
	if isShip and state.previewing == skin then
		local pc = Theme.card("Previewing on the ship", 3)
		T("Shown on " .. Preview.SHIP_NAME .. " exactly where the game mounts it. Move a piece, change its pivot, face, light or text in the model — the ship updates at once. Not saved, not undoable, gone when you stop.",
			{ TextColor3 = col.dim, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pc
		local pr = Theme.row(8, 2, 32)
		Theme.button("Next " .. skin.slot:lower(), "secondary", function()
			state.previewItem += 1
			Preview.focus(skin.slot, state.previewItem)
		end, { LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = pr
		Theme.button("Whole ship", "secondary", function() Preview.focusShip() end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = pr
		local theme = themeOf(skin)
		if theme then
			Theme.button("Whole theme: " .. theme, "secondary", function()
				-- start clean too: a slot this theme has no skin for shows the default, not a leftover
				Preview.stopLive()
				Preview.clearAll()
				state.previewing = nil
				local n = 0
				for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
					if s.kind == "ship" and ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
						local sr = state.results[s] or inspectOne(s)
						if sr.plan and Preview.show(s, sr.plan) then n += 1 end
					end
				end
				paintBody(skin)
				Preview.focusShip()
				toast("Showing " .. n .. " " .. theme .. " skins on the ship. " .. (state.paintSource or ""), "ok")
				renderDetail()
			end, { LayoutOrder = 3 }).Parent = pr
		end
		Theme.button("Stop preview", "ghost", function()
			stopPreview()
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pr
		pr.Parent = pc
		local bodyRow = Theme.row(10, 3, 32)
		T("Body colours", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = bodyRow
		Theme.segmented({ { "theme", "Theme colours" }, { "default", "Default" } }, state.bodyPaint == false and "default" or "theme", function(k)
			state.bodyPaint = k == "theme"
			paintBody(skin)
			renderDetail()
		end, { LayoutOrder = 2 }).Parent = bodyRow
		bodyRow.Parent = pc
		if state.paintSource then
			T(state.paintSource, { TextColor3 = col.dim, TextSize = 12, LayoutOrder = 4 }).Parent = pc
		end
		if skin.slot == "Board" then
			local nameRow = Theme.row(8, 3, 32)
			T("Name on the board", { TextColor3 = col.dim, Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None, LayoutOrder = 1 }).Parent = nameRow
			local box = Theme.input("SAIL ME", Preview.boardName, { Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30), LayoutOrder = 2 })
			box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				Preview.boardName = box.Text ~= "" and box.Text or "SAIL ME"
				showPreview(skin, state.results[skin] or r)
			end)
			box.Parent = nameRow
			nameRow.Parent = pc
		end
		pc.Parent = d
	end

	-- SETUP
	local st = isShip and Setup.status(skin)
	if st then
		local sc = Theme.card("Setup", 4)
		if st.kind == "face" then
			T(st.has and "This wheel has Billy's face. Move, scale or recolour its FaceRig — or copy a fresh one." or
				"This wheel has no face yet. Billy needs one on every wheel skin.", { LayoutOrder = 1, TextColor3 = st.has and col.dim or col.text }).Parent = sc
			local same = Setup.faceDonor(skin.model)
			local sr = Theme.row(8, 2, 32)

-- BODY COLOURS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- One row per theme (a skin theme tag, a catalogue set, or a colour ship's tag). The editor
-- tunes the six paint groups with sliders / RGB / swatches, repaints the preview ship live,
-- creates or updates the theme's colour ship in workspace.ship, and Approve writes the
-- theme's BODY_COLORS entry into SkinCatalog.
local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

state.drafts = {} -- [theme] = { [group] = Color3 } being edited
state.bodyGroup = "Hull"

local function bodyThemes()
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local set = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		local t = ShipSkins.themeOf(s)
		if t then set[t] = true end
	end
	for k in pairs(cat and cat.BodyPackage or {}) do
		if k ~= "Default" then set[k] = true end
	end
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(m)) do
			if t:sub(1, 12) ~= "SkinSurface_" then set[t] = true end
		end
	end
	local list = {}
	for t in pairs(set) do table.insert(list, { kind = "body", key = t, slot = "Body" }) end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
	return list
end

-- what the shop and the colour ship hold for a theme right now
local function bodySources(theme)
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	local shop = Paint.fromCatalog(cat, theme)
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	local donorPalette = donor and Paint.read(donor) or nil
	return shop, donor, donorPalette, Paint.isStyle(cat, theme)
end

local function draftFor(theme)
	if state.drafts[theme] then return state.drafts[theme] end
	local shop, _, donorPalette = bodySources(theme)
	local base = Paint.defaults(ShipSkins.catalogData())
	local from = shop or donorPalette or {}
	local d = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = from[g] end
	-- the shop's own fallbacks (SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS loop): steps follow the mast, stairs the hull
	d.MastSteps = d.MastSteps or d.Mast
	d.Stairs = d.Stairs or d.Hull
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do d[g] = d[g] or base[g] end
	state.drafts[theme] = d
	return d
end

local pendingPaint = false
local function repaintLive(theme)
	if state.bodyPreview ~= theme or pendingPaint then return end
	pendingPaint = true
	task.defer(function()
		pendingPaint = false
		if state.bodyPreview == theme and Preview.exists() then Preview.paint(draftFor(theme)) end
	end)
end

local function previewTheme(theme)
	local n = 0
	for _, s in ipairs(ShipSkins.scan()) do
		if ShipSkins.inTheme(s, theme) then
			local r = ShipSkins.inspect(s, Website.get(s.key, s.slot) or nil)
			if r.plan and Preview.show(s, r.plan) then n += 1 end
		end
	end
	local cat = ShipSkins.catalogData()
	-- a texture-style body has no colour draft: show the style itself
	Preview.paint(Paint.isStyle(cat, theme) and (Preview.paletteFor(theme, cat)) or draftFor(theme))
	state.bodyPreview = theme
	state.previewing = nil
	Preview.focusShip()
	return n
end

		lvl, head = "warn", theme .. " is a texture style (per-part textures) — its body is not a colour set, so it is not edited here."
	elseif shop and matchesShop then
		lvl, head = "ok", "These colours are in the shop."
	elseif shop then
		lvl, head = "warn", "Edited — Approve to update the shop (then Publish SkinCatalog)."

	end
	local banner = new("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col[lvl], BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, LayoutOrder = 2 },

	end

	-- EDITOR
	local ed = Theme.card("Colours", 3)
	local rows = {}
	local sliders = {}
	local function paintChip(g)
		local c = draft[g]
		if chips[g] then chips[g].BackgroundColor3 = c end
		if rows[g] then
			rows[g].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
			if not rows[g].box:IsFocused() then rows[g].box.Text = Theme.rgb(c) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(c) end
		end
	end
	local function syncSliders()
		local c = draft[state.bodyGroup]
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		if sliders.h then
			sliders.h.set(h)
			sliders.s.set(s)
			sliders.v.set(v)
			sliders.s.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(h, 0, v), Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, math.max(v, 0.05)))
			sliders.v.grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromHSV(h, s, 1))
		end
	end
	-- UNDO: the draft is not an instance, so Studio's Ctrl+Z never sees it. Each change keeps
	-- the colour it replaced; a slider drag (changes to one part less than a second apart) is
	-- ONE step. Reset is a step too, so Undo brings the edits back.
	state.bodyHistory = state.bodyHistory or {}
	local hist = state.bodyHistory[theme] or {}
	state.bodyHistory[theme] = hist
	local refreshUndo = function() end -- set once the Undo button exists
	local function setColor(g, c, noHistory)
		if draft[g] == c then return end
		if not noHistory then
			local top = hist[#hist]
			if top and top.g == g and os.clock() - top.t < 1 then
				top.t = os.clock() -- the same drag: keep the colour from before it began
			else
				table.insert(hist, { g = g, c = draft[g], t = os.clock() })
				if #hist > 100 then table.remove(hist, 1) end
			end
		end
		draft[g] = c
		paintChip(g)
		if g == state.bodyGroup then syncSliders() end
		repaintLive(theme)
		refreshUndo()
	end
	-- the colour a part had before any editing: the shop's, else the colour ship's, else default
	local function savedColor(part)
		local shopNow, _, donorNow = bodySources(theme)
		local from = shopNow or donorNow or {}
		local base = Paint.defaults(ShipSkins.catalogData())
		return from[part] or (part == "MastSteps" and from.Mast) or (part == "Stairs" and from.Hull) or base[part]
	end
	for i, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local sel = g == state.bodyGroup
		local row = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), BackgroundColor3 = sel and col.selected or col.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 },
			{ Theme.corner(6) })
		local sw = new("Frame", { Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = draft[g], BorderSizePixel = 0 },
			{ Theme.corner(6), Theme.stroke(col.cardStroke) })
		sw.Parent = row
		T(Paint.LABEL[g], { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			FontFace = sel and Theme.fontMedium or Theme.font }).Parent = row
		local box = Theme.input("r, g, b  or  #hex", Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0.5, -14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 28), FontFace = Theme.fontMono, TextSize = 13 })
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local c = Theme.parseColor(box.Text:match("#%x+") or box.Text:gsub("%s+#%x+$", ""))
			if c then setColor(g, c) else box.Text = Theme.rgb(draft[g]) .. "   " .. Theme.hex(draft[g]) end
		end)
		box.Parent = row
		row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			state.bodyGroup = g
			renderBodyDetail()
		end)
		rows[g] = { swatch = sw, box = box }
		row.Parent = ed
	end
	-- sliders for the selected group
	local g = state.bodyGroup
	T("Tuning " .. Paint.LABEL[g], { FontFace = Theme.fontBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = 10 }).Parent = ed
	local h0, s0, v0 = draft[g]:ToHSV()
	local hueKeys = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do table.insert(hueKeys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1, 1, 1))) end
	local cur = { h = h0, s = s0, v = v0 }
	local function fromSliders()
		setColor(g, Color3.fromHSV(cur.h, cur.s, cur.v))
	end
	local hf, hset = Theme.slider("Hue", h0, ColorSequence.new(hueKeys), function(x) cur.h = x fromSliders() end, 11)
	local sf, sset, sgrad = Theme.slider("Saturation", s0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.s = x fromSliders() end, 12)
	local vf, vset, vgrad = Theme.slider("Brightness", v0, ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), function(x) cur.v = x fromSliders() end, 13)
	sliders.h = { set = hset }
	sliders.s = { set = sset, grad = sgrad }
	sliders.v = { set = vset, grad = vgrad }
	hf.Parent, sf.Parent, vf.Parent = ed, ed, ed
	syncSliders()
	Theme.swatches(Theme.SWATCHES, draft[g], function(c)
		local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
		cur.h, cur.s, cur.v = h, s, v
		setColor(g, c)
	end, 14).Parent = ed
	local quick = Theme.row(8, 15, 30)
	Theme.button("Stairs = Hull", "ghost", function() setColor("Stairs", draft.Hull) end, { LayoutOrder = 1, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	Theme.button("Mast steps = Mast", "ghost", function() setColor("MastSteps", draft.Mast) end, { LayoutOrder = 2, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	Theme.button("Reset all", "ghost", function()
		local before = table.clone(draft)
		state.drafts[theme] = nil
		local fresh = draftFor(theme)
		if not Paint.same(before, fresh) then
			table.insert(hist, { all = before, t = 0 })
		end
		repaintLive(theme)
		renderBodyDetail()
	end, { LayoutOrder = 3, TextSize = 12 }).Parent = quick
	quick.Parent = ed
	local undoRow = Theme.row(8, 16, 30)
	local undoB, undoApi = Theme.button(#hist > 0 and ("Undo  (" .. #hist .. ")") or "Undo", "secondary", function()
		local top = table.remove(hist)

		if top.all then

		else

-- REFRESH -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function refresh(fetchWeb)
	if not state.mode then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Nothing to check here — open the Assets place (ship skins) or PVP&NPC ASSETS (tool skins).", "warn")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "ship" or state.mode == "body" or state.mode == "preview" then ShipSkins.catalogData(true) end
	if state.mode == "preview" then
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast("Pick a theme to dress the ship with its whole set.")
		return
	end
	if state.mode == "body" then
		state.skins = bodyThemes()
		if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
		renderList()
		renderDetail()
		toast(string.format("%d themes. Pick one to tune its body colours.", #state.skins))
		return
	end
	state.skins = module().scan()
	table.clear(state.results)
	for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
	if state.selected and not table.find(state.skins, state.selected) then state.selected = nil end
	if App.selectKey then -- a jump from another tab ("Skins in this theme")
		for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do
			if s.key == App.selectKey then state.selected = s end
		end
		App.selectKey = nil
	end
	renderList()
	renderDetail()
	toast(string.format("Checked %d skins.", #state.skins))
	if fetchWeb then
		task.spawn(function()
			if not Website.token() then
				ui.webError = nil
				App.paintWebPill()
				return
			end
			toast("Asking the website about " .. #state.skins .. " skins…")
			local names = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do table.insert(names, s.key) end
			local ok, err = Website.fetch(names)
			ui.webError = (not ok) and err or nil
			App.paintWebPill(ok)
			for _, s in ipairs(state.skins) do inspectOne(s) end
			renderList()
			renderDetail()
			toast(ok and string.format("%d skins checked against the catalogue and the website.", #state.skins) or err, ok and "ok" or "warn")
		end)
	end
end

function App.paintWebPill(ok)
	if ui.rolePill then
		ui.rolePill.Text = Review.isOwner() and "OWNER" or "DESIGNER"
		ui.rolePill.TextColor3 = Review.isOwner() and col.ok or col.accent
		ui.rolePill.BackgroundColor3 = ui.rolePill.TextColor3
	end
	if not ui.webPill then return end
	state.webOk = ok
	local text
	if not Website.token() then
		text = "Add website token"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.warn
	elseif ok == false then
		text = "Website unreachable"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.bad
	else
		text = "Website connected"
		ui.webPill.TextColor3 = col.ok
	end
	-- a narrow dock shows only the dot (fitHeader); the words stay a click away in Settings
	ui.webPill.Text = state.compactHeader and "●" or ("●  " .. text)
end

	local leftL, rightL = left:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), right:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")

modules.CatalogText:
--[[
	CatalogText — find, replace or insert ONE skin row inside the SkinCatalog
	module source, leaving every other byte as it was.

	The catalogue is one module (~120k characters). Each slot is a block
	`SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }` and each skin a row indented by one tab,
	optionally preceded by a `-- <Key>: ...` comment line:

		-- MidNightLantern: Assets workspace.Lantern.MidNightLantern, tag MidNight (added 2026-09-23)
		MidNightLantern = { price = 100, tier = "Common", pieces = {
			...
		} },

	Some blocks are one line (`SkinCatalog.Door = { Default = { ... } }`); an
	insert turns them into a multi-line block.
]]

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local CatalogText = {}

local function escape(s)
	return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0"))
end

-- start/end index of the `{` and `}` of SkinCatalog.<Slot> = { ... }
function CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	local _, e = src:find("\nSkinCatalog%." .. escape(slot) .. "%s*=%s*{")
	if not e then return nil end
	local close = Util.matchBrace(src, e)
	if not close then return nil end
	return e, close
end

-- the row of `key` inside a block: rowStart (first char of its comment or key line),
-- rowEnd (last char before the newline that ends the row), and the row text
function CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	local pat = "\n\t" .. escape(Util.keyExpr(key)) .. "%s*=%s*{"
	local a, b = src:find(pat, open)
	if not a or a > close then return nil end
	local rowClose = Util.matchBrace(src, b)
	if not rowClose or rowClose > close then return nil end
	-- the rest of the row's last line: a trailing comma and/or comment
	local nl = src:find("\n", rowClose, true) or (close - 1)
	local rowEnd = nl - 1
	local rowStart = a + 1
	-- the comment line above, when it names this key
	local prevStart = src:sub(1, a - 1):match(".*\n()")
	if prevStart then
		local prevLine = src:sub(prevStart, a - 1)
		if prevLine:match("^\t%-%- " .. escape(key) .. ":") then rowStart = prevStart end
	end
	return rowStart, rowEnd, src:sub(rowStart, rowEnd)
end

-- the current row text for `key` in `slot`, or nil
function CatalogText.getRow(src, slot, key)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then return nil end
	local _, _, text = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	return text
end

-- src with `rowText` in place of the key's row (or added at the end of the block).
-- rowText: the full row, comment line included, ending in "," and NO trailing newline
function CatalogText.upsert(src, slot, key, rowText)
	local open, close = CatalogText.findBlock(src, slot)
	if not open then
		error("SkinCatalog has no block `SkinCatalog." .. slot .. " = {` — add the slot to the catalogue first")
	end
	local rowStart, rowEnd = CatalogText.findRow(src, open, close, key)
	if rowStart then
		return src:sub(1, rowStart - 1) .. rowText .. src:sub(rowEnd + 1), "replaced"
	end
	local before = src:sub(1, close - 1):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local last = before:sub(-1)
	if last ~= "," and last ~= "{" then before ..= "," end
	return before .. "\n" .. rowText .. "\n" .. src:sub(close), "added"
end

-- rows compared without their comment line and whitespace
function CatalogText.same(a, b)
	if not (a and b) then return false end
	local function norm(t)
		t = t:gsub("^\t%-%-[^\n]*\n", "")
		return (t:gsub("%s+", ""))
	end
	return norm(a) == norm(b)
end

return CatalogText

modules.Paint:
--[[
	Paint — a theme's BODY colours: the six paint groups Hull, Deck, Rim, Mast,
	MastSteps and Stairs (the catalogue's paint slots).

	Where they live:
	  the shop     one entry per theme in SkinCatalog's `local BODY_COLORS = { ... }`
	               table ({ color, hull, deck, rim, mast, mastSteps?, stairs?,
	               groupPrice, packagePrice }); a loop there makes the six paint rows
	               and the Body-tab BodyPackage row. Paint is NOT gated by the website:
	               a set is on sale as soon as the SkinCatalog Package is published.
	  the designer a lean colour ship in workspace.ship tagged with the theme (what the
	               ColorTuner used to park), which the Style Preview reads.

	The paint rule is SkinService's: every instance tagged SkinSurface_<Group> — the part
	takes the colour, and so do its own Texture overlays (not ones tagged for another
	group) and its SurfaceAppearance; a tagged Texture takes it too.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local Paint = {}

Paint.GROUPS = { "Hull", "Deck", "Rim", "Mast", "MastSteps", "Stairs" }
Paint.LABEL = { Hull = "Hull", Deck = "Deck", Rim = "Rim", Mast = "Mast", MastSteps = "Mast steps", Stairs = "Stairs" }
-- the BODY_COLORS field each group is written to
local FIELD = { Hull = "hull", Deck = "deck", Rim = "rim", Mast = "mast", MastSteps = "mastSteps", Stairs = "stairs" }

local function isWhite(c) return c.R > 0.96 and c.G > 0.96 and c.B > 0.96 end

-- paint every tagged instance under `root`; `remember(fn)` (optional) receives an undo for each change
function Paint.apply(root, palette, remember)
	for group, col in pairs(palette) do
		local myTag = "SkinSurface_" .. group
		for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(myTag)) do
			if inst:IsDescendantOf(root) then
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
					local was = inst.Color
					inst.Color = col
					if remember then remember(function() inst.Color = was end) end
					for _, ch in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
						if ch:IsA("Texture") then
							local foreign = false
							for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(ch)) do
								if t:find("^SkinSurface_") and t ~= myTag then foreign = true break end
							end
							if not foreign then
								local c3 = ch.Color3
								ch.Color3 = col
								if remember then remember(function() ch.Color3 = c3 end) end
							end
						elseif ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
							local sc = ch.Color
							ch.Color = col
							if remember then remember(function() if ch.Parent then ch.Color = sc end end) end
						end
					end
				elseif inst:IsA("Texture") then
					local c3 = inst.Color3
					inst.Color3 = col
					if remember then remember(function() inst.Color3 = c3 end) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- a model's colours, read the way the Style Preview reads a donor:
-- SurfaceAppearance colour over part colour, the first non-white per group
function Paint.read(model)
	local palette = {}
	for _, group in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local tag = "SkinSurface_" .. group
		local first, chosen
		for _, inst in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if CollectionService:HasTag(inst, tag) then
				local c
				if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
					local sa = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
					c = sa and sa.Color or inst.Color
				elseif inst:IsA("Texture") then
					c = inst.Color3
				end
				if c then
					first = first or c
					if not isWhite(c) then chosen = c break end
				end
			end
		end
		if chosen or first then palette[group] = chosen or first end
	end
	return palette
end

-- the colour ships -------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Paint.donorFolder()
	return workspace:FindFirstChild("ship")
end

function Paint.findDonor(theme)
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and CollectionService:HasTag(m, theme) then return m end
	end
	return nil
end

-- a donor to copy geometry from: a plain colour set (not a full-look texture style)
local function baseDonor()
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	for _, m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
		if m:IsA("Model") and not m:GetAttribute("FullLook") and m.Name ~= "Ship_Gold" and m:FindFirstChild("Structure") then
			return m
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- a new colour ship for `theme` at the end of the row in workspace.ship
function Paint.createDonor(theme, palette)
	local folder = Paint.donorFolder()
	if not folder then return nil, "No workspace.ship folder." end
	local base = baseDonor()
	if not base then return nil, "No colour ship in workspace.ship to copy the body from." end
	local copy = base:Clone()
	copy.Name = theme .. "Colours"
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(copy)) do CollectionService:RemoveTag(copy, t) end
	CollectionService:AddTag(copy, theme)
	copy:SetAttribute("Style", theme)
	-- line it up after the last ship in the row (the row runs along -X), one usual gap on
	local xs, rowCF, minX = {}, base:GetPivot(), math.huge
	for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if m:IsA("Model") then
			local p = m:GetPivot()
			table.insert(xs, p.X)
			if p.X < minX then minX, rowCF = p.X, p end
		end
	end
	table.sort(xs)
	local gaps = {}
	for i = 2, #xs do
		if xs[i] - xs[i - 1] > 5 then table.insert(gaps, xs[i] - xs[i - 1]) end
	end
	table.sort(gaps)
	local gap = #gaps > 0 and gaps[math.ceil(#gaps / 2)] or 40
	copy:PivotTo(rowCF - Vector3.new(gap, 0, 0))
	-- parent BEFORE painting: CollectionService only returns tagged instances in the DataModel
	copy.Parent = folder
	Paint.apply(copy, palette)
	return copy
end

-- the shop: SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS entries --------------------------------------------------
-- the BODY_COLORS entry as a palette, from the loaded catalogue's paint rows
function Paint.fromCatalog(catalog, theme)
	if not catalog then return nil end
	local palette = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local e = catalog[g] and catalog[g][theme]
		if e and not e.style and typeof(e.color) == "Color3" then palette[g] = e.color end
	end
	return next(palette) and palette or nil
end

-- the texture style a theme's body uses: its own style rows, or a style whose rows name the
-- theme in their `theme` field (BODY_STYLES in SkinCatalog: Gold is GoldenCat's body, 2026-09-28 —
-- the key stays Gold because players own it)
function Paint.styleKey(catalog, theme)
	local hull = catalog and catalog.Hull
	if not hull then return nil end
	local e = hull[theme]
	if e and e.style == true then return theme end
	for key, row in pairs(hull) do
		if type(row) == "table" and row.style == true and row.theme == theme then return key end
	end
	return nil
end

function Paint.isStyle(catalog, theme)
	return Paint.styleKey(catalog, theme) ~= nil
end

-- the default body colours (the catalogue's Default rows)
function Paint.defaults(catalog)
	local palette = {}
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local e = catalog and catalog[g] and catalog[g].Default
		palette[g] = (e and typeof(e.color) == "Color3") and e.color or Color3.fromRGB(184, 93, 40)
	end
	return palette
end

-- one BODY_COLORS entry, comment line included, no trailing newline
function Paint.entryText(theme, palette, keep)
	local c = function(g) return Util.color3(palette[g]) end
	local lines = {
		string.format("\t%s = { -- ZAAL Assets plugin %s%s", Util.keyExpr(theme), os.date("%Y-%m-%d"),
			keep.donor and (", colour ship workspace.ship." .. keep.donor) or ""),
		"\t\tcolor = " .. c("Hull") .. ",",
		"\t\thull  = " .. c("Hull") .. ", deck = " .. c("Deck") .. ",",
		"\t\trim   = " .. c("Rim") .. ", mast = " .. c("Mast") .. ",",
		"\t\tmastSteps = " .. c("MastSteps") .. ", stairs = " .. c("Stairs") .. ",",
		string.format("\t\tgroupPrice = %s, packagePrice = %s,", Util.num(keep.groupPrice or 25), Util.num(keep.packagePrice or 60)),
		"\t},",
	}
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- src with the theme's entry replaced or added inside `local BODY_COLORS = { ... }`
function Paint.upsert(src, theme, entryText)
	local _, e = src:find("\nlocal BODY_COLORS%s*=%s*{")
	if not e then error("SkinCatalog has no `local BODY_COLORS = {` table") end
	local close = Util.matchBrace(src, e)
	if not close then error("BODY_COLORS table is not closed") end
	local key = Util.keyExpr(theme):gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?]", "%%%0")
	local a, b = src:find("\n\t" .. key .. "%s*=%s*{", e)
	if a and a < close then
		local rowClose = Util.matchBrace(src, b)
		local nl = src:find("\n", rowClose, true) or close
		return src:sub(1, a) .. entryText .. src:sub(nl), "updated"
	end
	local before = src:sub(1, close - 1):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local last = before:sub(-1)
	if last ~= "," and last ~= "{" then before ..= "," end
	return before .. "\n" .. entryText .. "\n" .. src:sub(close), "added"
end

-- the prices an existing entry had (so an edit keeps them)
function Paint.keepFrom(catalog, theme)
	local hull = catalog and catalog.Hull and catalog.Hull[theme]
	local pkg = catalog and catalog.BodyPackage and catalog.BodyPackage[theme]
	return { groupPrice = hull and hull.price, packagePrice = pkg and pkg.price }
end

-- write the theme's BODY_COLORS entry into SkinCatalog (one undo step); returns ok, message
function Paint.approve(theme, palette, module, catalog)
	local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
	local ScriptEditorService = game:GetService("ScriptEditorService")
	if not module then return false, "No ReplicatedStorage.SkinCatalog in this place." end
	if not Util.isIdentifier(theme) then return false, "'" .. theme .. "' is not a valid catalogue key." end
	local keep = Paint.keepFrom(catalog, theme)
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	keep.donor = donor and donor.Name or nil
	local rec = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("ZAALAssetsBody", "Body colours " .. theme)
	local function cancel(msg)
		if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Cancel) end
		return false, msg
	end
	local old = ScriptEditorService:GetEditorSource(module)
	local okSplice, newSource, how = pcall(Paint.upsert, old, theme, Paint.entryText(theme, palette, keep))
	if not okSplice then return cancel(tostring(newSource)) end
	local probe = module:Clone()
	probe.Source = newSource
	local okLoad, data = pcall(require, probe)
	probe:Destroy()
	if not (okLoad and type(data) == "table" and data.Hull and data.Hull[theme] and data.BodyPackage and data.BodyPackage[theme]) then
		return cancel("The new catalogue did not load (" .. tostring(okLoad and "rows missing" or data) .. ") — nothing was changed.")
	end
	local okWrite, err = pcall(function()
		ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(module, function() return newSource end)
	end)
	if not okWrite then return cancel("Could not write SkinCatalog: " .. tostring(err)) end
	if rec then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(rec, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	return true, string.format("%s %s's body colours in SkinCatalog's BODY_COLORS (six paint rows + the Body-tab set). Right-click SkinCatalog → Publish Package — paint is on sale as soon as it is published.",
		how == "added" and "Added" or "Updated", theme)
end

-- do two palettes agree on every group BOTH carry? (the older colour ships were never
-- tagged for MastSteps / Stairs, so those groups are simply absent from them)
function Paint.same(a, b)
	if not (a and b) then return false end
	local compared = 0
	for _, g in ipairs(Paint.GROUPS) do
		local x, y = a[g], b[g]
		if x and y then
			compared += 1
			if math.abs(x.R - y.R) + math.abs(x.G - y.G) + math.abs(x.B - y.B) > 3 / 255 then return false end
		end
	end
	return compared > 0
end

return Paint
modules.Preview:
--[[
	Preview — shows a skin on a copy of the ship, exactly where the game puts it.

	The ship is a copy of ServerStorage.ShipTemplate named ZAAL_PreviewShip, with
	Archivable = false: it is never saved into the place, never copied into a
	playtest, and building it adds nothing to the undo history. Scripts are removed
	and every part is anchored (nothing simulates in edit mode anyway).

	WHERE a piece goes comes from SkinSockets — the very module the Arena's and the
	Shipyard's SkinService use — with the same rule as SkinService.mountMesh:
	piece.PivotOffset = the row's pivot, PivotTo(targetCF or socket frame). The
	piece itself is a copy of the designer's part, so its size already is
	MeshSize × scale and its texture / SurfaceAppearance are the real art.
	The extras mirror SkinService's applyExtras: wheel face pose + colours (other
	mouth frames follow MouthHappyRest), the lantern candle rig swap, the board's
	text plane + name (drawn by the game's own ShipNameText).

	Live: while a skin is shown, edits to its model (move, pivot, size, face rig,
	candle rig, text attributes) re-show it on the next frame.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local SkinSockets = require(script.Parent.SkinSockets)
local ShipNameText = require(script.Parent.ShipNameText)
local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Paint = require(script.Parent.Paint)

local Preview = {}

local SHIP_NAME = "ZAAL_PreviewShip"
Preview.SHIP_NAME = SHIP_NAME
Preview.boardName = "SAIL ME"

local state = {
	ship = nil,
	slots = {}, -- [slot] = { restore = { fn, ... }, key = skin key }
	liveConns = {},
	liveSkins = {},
	pending = false,
	onLive = nil,
}

-- the preview ship ------------------------------------------------------------------
local function placeFor(ship)
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("PreviewShipSpawn")
	if pad and pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		return pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(160, 12, 0)
	end
	return CFrame.new(0, 40, 1200)
end

function Preview.ship()
	if state.ship and state.ship.Parent then return state.ship end
	local stale = workspace:FindFirstChild(SHIP_NAME)
	if stale then stale:Destroy() end
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ShipTemplate")
	if not template then return nil, "No ServerStorage.ShipTemplate in this place." end
	local ship = template:Clone()
	ship.Name = SHIP_NAME
	ship.Archivable = false
	for _, d in ipairs(ship:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			d:Destroy()
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = true
		elseif d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			d.Enabled = false
		end
	end
	ship:PivotTo(placeFor(ship))
	ship.Parent = workspace
	state.ship = ship
	table.clear(state.slots)
	return ship
end

function Preview.exists()
	return state.ship ~= nil and state.ship.Parent ~= nil
end

-- restore bookkeeping ----------------------------------------------------------------
local function remember(slot, fn)
	state.slots[slot] = state.slots[slot] or { restore = {} }
	table.insert(state.slots[slot].restore, fn)
end

local function hide(slot, part)
	local t = part.Transparency
	part.Transparency = 1
	remember(slot, function() if part.Parent then part.Transparency = t end end)
end

function Preview.clearSlot(slot)
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	if not s then return end
	for i = #s.restore, 1, -1 do pcall(s.restore[i]) end
	state.slots[slot] = nil
end

function Preview.clearAll()
	for slot in pairs(state.slots) do Preview.clearSlot(slot) end
end

function Preview.destroy()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.restoreLight()
	if state.ship then state.ship:Destroy() end
	state.ship = nil
	table.clear(state.slots)
end

-- extras ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function poseFace(slot, ship, rot, face)
	local props = ship:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local faces = props and props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
	local rig = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
	if not (rig and rot) then return end
	-- remember the authored face
	local savedScale = rig:GetScale()
	local saved = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local sa = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
			saved[d] = { cf = d.CFrame, color = d.Color, sa = sa and sa.Color, saInst = sa }
		end
	end
	remember(slot, function()
		rig:ScaleTo(savedScale)
		for p, v in pairs(saved) do
			if p.Parent then
				p.CFrame = v.cf
				p.Color = v.color
				if v.saInst and v.sa then v.saInst.Color = v.sa end
			end
		end
	end)
	local motors = {}
	for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part0 and d.Part1 then motors[d.Part1] = d end
	end
	local hub = rot:GetPivot()
	rig:ScaleTo(face.FaceScale or savedScale)
	local rest = rig:FindFirstChild("MouthHappyRest", true)
	local restOff = face.Face_MouthHappyRest_Offset
	-- authored offsets AFTER scaling, measured from the hub, for the follow-Rest frames
	local scaledRel = {}
	for p in pairs(saved) do scaledRel[p] = hub:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame) end
	for p in pairs(saved) do
		if not motors[p] then
			local off = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_Offset"]
			if typeof(off) ~= "CFrame" and rest and p ~= rest and p.Parent == rest.Parent
				and p.Name:match("^MouthHappy") and typeof(restOff) == "CFrame" then
				off = restOff * scaledRel[rest]:ToObjectSpace(scaledRel[p])
			end
			if typeof(off) == "CFrame" then p.CFrame = hub * off end
		end
	end
	-- anchored preview parts do not follow their motors: place the eyes by hand
	for p, m in pairs(motors) do
		p.CFrame = m.Part0.CFrame * m.C0 * m.C1:Inverse()
	end
	for p, v in pairs(saved) do
		local color = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_Color"]
		local saColor = face["Face_" .. p.Name .. "_SAColor"]
		if color == nil and saColor == nil and rest and p ~= rest and p.Name:match("^MouthHappy") then
			color, saColor = face.Face_MouthHappyRest_Color, face.Face_MouthHappyRest_SAColor
		end
		if typeof(color) == "Color3" then p.Color = color end
		if v.saInst and typeof(saColor) == "Color3" then v.saInst.Color = saColor end
	end
	-- the posed face, to tell a later drag on the ship from the model's own pose
	local snap = {}
	for p in pairs(saved) do snap[p] = p.CFrame end
	if state.slots[slot] then
		state.slots[slot].faceSnapshot = snap
		state.slots[slot].faceScale = rig:GetScale()
	end
end

local function swapCandle(slot, item, candle)
	local fitile = item:FindFirstChild("Fitile", true)
	if not fitile then return end
	local removed = {}
	local enabled = true
	for _, c in ipairs(fitile:GetChildren()) do
		if (c:IsA("Light") or c:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) and not c:GetAttribute("FixedLight") then
			enabled = enabled and c.Enabled
			table.insert(removed, c)
			c.Parent = nil
		end
	end
	local added = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(candle:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Light") or c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local k = c:Clone()
			k.Enabled = enabled
			k.Parent = fitile
			table.insert(added, k)
		end
	end
	remember(slot, function()
		for _, k in ipairs(added) do k:Destroy() end
		for _, c in ipairs(removed) do c.Parent = fitile end
	end)
end

local function styleOf(text)
	local font = ShipNameText.FONT
	if text.font then
		local weight, style = Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal
		for _, w in Enum.FontWeight:GetEnumItems() do if w.Name == text.weight then weight = w end end
		for _, s in Enum.FontStyle:GetEnumItems() do if s.Name == text.style then style = s end end
		font = Font.new(text.font, weight, style)
	end
	return {
		font = font,
		color = text.color or ShipNameText.COLOR,
		outline = text.outline or ShipNameText.OUTLINE,
		thick = text.thickness or ShipNameText.THICK,
		scale = text.scale or 1,
	}
end

local function showBoardText(slot, item, text)
	local plane = item:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane")
	if not plane then return end
	local cf, size = plane.CFrame, plane.Size
	local oldGui = plane:FindFirstChild("ShipNameGui")
	if oldGui then oldGui.Parent = nil end
	if text then
		plane.Size = text.size
		plane.CFrame = item.CFrame * text.plane
	end
	local gui = ShipNameText.build(plane.Size, Preview.boardName, text and styleOf(text) or ShipNameText.styleFromBoard(item))
	if gui then gui.Parent = plane end
	if state.slots[slot] then state.slots[slot].planeExpected = { plane = plane, cf = plane.CFrame, size = plane.Size } end
	remember(slot, function()
		if gui then gui:Destroy() end
		plane.CFrame, plane.Size = cf, size
		if oldGui then oldGui.Parent = plane end
	end)
end

-- show one skin -----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- skin = { slot, key, model }, plan = ShipSkins.inspect(...).plan
function Preview.show(skin, plan)
	local ship, why = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return false, why end
	local slot = skin.slot
	Preview.clearSlot(slot)
	state.slots[slot] = { restore = {}, key = skin.key, mounts = {}, model = skin.model, plan = plan }
	local def = Slots.SHIP[slot]

	if def.texture then
		if not plan.sail then return false, "No SurfaceAppearance to show." end
		for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SkinSurface_" .. slot)) do
			if part:IsDescendantOf(ship) and part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local old = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
				if old then old.Parent = nil end
				local sa = plan.sail:Clone()
				sa.Parent = part
				remember(slot, function()
					sa:Destroy()
					if old then old.Parent = part end
				end)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local geo = SkinSockets.slots[slot]
	if not geo then return false, "The game has no " .. slot .. " slot." end
	local mounted = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(geo.items(ship)) do
		local sockets = geo.sockets(item)
		local mountedOn = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(plan.pieces) do
			local socket = sockets[p.socket]
			if socket then
				local clone = p.part:Clone()
				for _, ch in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
					if not ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then ch:Destroy() end
				end
				-- SkinService.stampDefaults: the socket's authored mesh lends its look
				local dm = socket:FindFirstChild("DefaultMesh")
				if dm then
					clone.CastShadow, clone.Reflectance, clone.Material = dm.CastShadow, dm.Reflectance, dm.Material
				end
				clone.Transparency = p.transparency or 0
				clone.PivotOffset = p.pivot
				clone.Anchored, clone.CanCollide, clone.CanQuery, clone.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
				clone.Name = socket.Name .. "Preview"
				clone:SetAttribute("SkinMesh", true)
				local target = geo.targetCF and geo.targetCF(p.socket, sockets, { rig = def.rig }) or socket.CFrame
				clone:PivotTo(target)
				clone.Parent = socket
				local placed = clone.CFrame
				if geo.postMount then geo.postMount(p.socket, sockets, clone) end
				-- what the game would do with this piece, to read a designer's drag back later
				table.insert(state.slots[slot].mounts, { clone = clone, part = p.part, target = target,
					expected = clone.CFrame, shift = clone.CFrame.Position - placed.Position, size = clone.Size, item = item })
				mountedOn[socket] = true
				mounted += 1
				remember(slot, function() clone:Destroy() end)
			end
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(geo.hideParts(item)) do
			if part.Name ~= "DefaultMesh" then
				if mountedOn[part.Parent] then hide(slot, part) end
			elseif next(mountedOn) then
				hide(slot, part)
			end
		end
		if plan.candle then swapCandle(slot, item, plan.candle) end
		if slot == "Board" then showBoardText(slot, item, plan.text) end
		if plan.face then poseFace(slot, ship, sockets.RotationPart, plan.face) end
	end
	if mounted == 0 then return false, "No socket on the ship took a piece — check the piece names." end
	return true
end

-- BODY PAINT --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The body's colours are the paint groups (Hull, Deck, Rim, Mast, MastSteps, Stairs): a theme's
-- BODY_COLORS entry in the catalogue, else its colour ship in workspace.ship. Painted with
-- SkinService's rule (Paint.apply); every change is remembered and undone on clear.
Preview.PAINT_SLOTS = Paint.GROUPS

-- palette { [group] = Color3 } for a theme + where it came from (nil palette when none).
-- A texture-style body comes back as { style = <style key> } instead of colours.
function Preview.paletteFor(theme, catalog)
	local styleKey = Paint.styleKey(catalog, theme)
	if styleKey then
		return { style = styleKey }, "the catalogue's " .. styleKey .. " texture style"
			.. (styleKey ~= theme and (" (" .. theme .. "'s body)") or "")
	end
	local fromCat = Paint.fromCatalog(catalog, theme)
	if fromCat then return fromCat, "the catalogue's " .. theme .. " paint" end
	local donor = Paint.findDonor(theme)
	if donor then
		local p = Paint.read(donor)
		if next(p) then return p, "the colour ship workspace.ship." .. donor.Name .. " (not in the shop catalogue yet)" end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- TEXTURE STYLES (2026-09-28): a style body is per-part data in SkinCatalog.SkinStyles
-- ([style][group]["<path from the ship root>"] = override), applied with the style rule of
-- SkinService.applyTextureSlot: a tagged part with an override takes its SurfaceAppearance
-- (SkinAppearances.<Group>.<Style>.<sa>, or none for saRemove), colour, material and
-- MaterialVariant, and its own Texture overlays (not ones tagged for another group) take the
-- override's texture + tint; a tagged Texture is looked up as "<path>@<Face>" first. Parts
-- without an override keep the authored look, which the preview ship already has.
local function relPath(inst, root)
	local seg = {}
	local n = inst
	while n and n ~= root do
		table.insert(seg, 1, n.Name)
		n = n.Parent
	end
	return table.concat(seg, ".")
end

local function stylesData()
	local cat = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("SkinCatalog")
	local m = cat and cat:FindFirstChild("SkinStyles")
	if not m then return nil end
	local ok, data = pcall(require, m:Clone()) -- a clone, so a stale require cache never lies
	return ok and type(data) == "table" and data or nil
end

local function paintStyle(ship, key, keep)
	local styles = stylesData()
	local style = styles and styles[key]
	if not style then return false end
	local saRoot = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SkinAppearances")
	local function retexture(tex, ov)
		if not (ov and (ov.texture or ov.textureTint)) then return end
		local c3, img = tex.Color3, tex.Texture
		if ov.textureTint then tex.Color3 = ov.textureTint end
		if ov.texture then tex.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. ov.texture end
		keep(function() tex.Color3 = c3; tex.Texture = img end)
	end
	for group, parts in pairs(style) do
		local myTag = "SkinSurface_" .. group
		local saGroup = saRoot and saRoot:FindFirstChild(group)
		local saFolder = saGroup and saGroup:FindFirstChild(key)
		for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(myTag)) do
			if not inst:IsDescendantOf(ship) then continue end
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
				local ov = parts[relPath(inst, ship)]
				if not ov then continue end
				local source = ov.sa and saFolder and saFolder:FindFirstChild(ov.sa)
				if source or ov.saRemove then
					for _, sa in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
						if sa:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
							sa.Parent = nil
							keep(function() sa.Parent = inst end)
						end
					end
					if source then
						local c = source:Clone()
						c.Parent = inst
						keep(function() c:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
				local color, material, variant = inst.Color, inst.Material, inst.MaterialVariant
				if ov.color then inst.Color = ov.color end
				if ov.material and Enum.Material[ov.material] then inst.Material = Enum.Material[ov.material] end
				if ov.materialVariant then inst.MaterialVariant = ov.materialVariant end
				keep(function() inst.Color = color; inst.Material = material; inst.MaterialVariant = variant end)
				for _, k in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
					if k:IsA("Texture") then
						local foreign = false
						for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(k)) do
							if t:find("^SkinSurface_") and t ~= myTag then foreign = true break end
						end
						if not foreign then retexture(k, ov) end
					end
				end
			elseif inst:IsA("Texture") then
				local rp = relPath(inst, ship)
				retexture(inst, parts[rp .. "@" .. inst.Face.Name] or parts[rp])
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Preview.paint(palette)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return false end
	Preview.clearSlot("Paint")
	if not palette then return true end
	state.slots.Paint = { restore = {} }
	local keep = function(fn) remember("Paint", fn) end
	if palette.style then return paintStyle(ship, palette.style, keep) end
	Paint.apply(ship, palette, keep)
	return true
end

-- LIGHTING --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Day / sunset / night on Lighting.ClockTime, to judge a set (and its lantern light) in both
-- lights. The original time is remembered and put back on restore / when the plugin closes, so
-- a save never keeps the night.
local savedClock = nil
Preview.LIGHTS = { day = 14, sunset = 18.2, night = 22 }
function Preview.setLight(mode)
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	if savedClock == nil then savedClock = Lighting.ClockTime end
	Lighting.ClockTime = Preview.LIGHTS[mode] or savedClock
end
function Preview.restoreLight()
	if savedClock ~= nil then
		game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime = savedClock
		savedClock = nil
	end
end
function Preview.lightChanged() return savedClock ~= nil end

-- EDITS BACK TO THE MODEL ------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The designer may drag / rotate / resize a preview piece on the ship with Studio's tools. Taking
-- it back: the piece's authored PivotOffset becomes the one that lands it where it now is
-- (PivotTo(target) with pivot P puts the part at target * P⁻¹, so P = cframe⁻¹ * target; a door's
-- hinge spread is added by the game after the pivot, so it is taken off first) and its Size is
-- copied (scale = Size / MeshSize). Window pieces also get their FitScale / FitOffset attributes.
-- Returns a list of plain-words changes, applied to the Assets model.
-- give an Assets piece a new pivot WITHOUT moving its socket point: the piece (and anything
-- nested in it, like a board's name plane) moves so that it sits where the new pivot says —
-- so the model in the folder always shows what the ship will show, and its layout stays
-- consistent for the pivot check
function Preview.setPivot(part, newPivot)
	local socketPoint = part.CFrame * part.PivotOffset
	local before = part.CFrame
	part.PivotOffset = newPivot
	part.CFrame = socketPoint * newPivot:Inverse()
	local delta = part.CFrame * before:Inverse()
	for _, d in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CFrame = delta * d.CFrame end
	end
	if part:GetAttribute("FitOffset") ~= nil then part:SetAttribute("FitOffset", newPivot.Position) end
end

function Preview.pull(slot)
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	if not s or not s.mounts then return {} end
	local changes, done = {}, {}
	for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
		if m.clone.Parent and not done[m.part] then
			local _, turned = (m.clone.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * m.expected.Rotation):ToAxisAngle()
			local moved = (m.clone.CFrame.Position - m.expected.Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 or math.abs(turned) > 1e-4
			local resized = (m.clone.Size - m.size).Magnitude > 1e-4
			if moved or resized then
				done[m.part] = true
				local pose = m.clone.CFrame - m.shift
				local newPivot = pose:Inverse() * m.target
				if resized then
					m.part.Size = m.clone.Size
					local native = m.part:GetAttribute("NativeSize")
					if typeof(native) == "Vector3" and native.X > 0 then
						m.part:SetAttribute("FitScale", m.part.Size / native)
					end
				end
				Preview.setPivot(m.part, newPivot)
				table.insert(changes, m.part.Name .. (moved and " moved" or "") .. (resized and " resized" or ""))
			end
		end
	end
	-- the wheel face: its parts' poses go back onto the model's FaceRig, relative to the hub
	if slot == "Wheel" and s.model:FindFirstChild("FaceRig") then
		local ship = state.ship
		local faces = ship and ship:FindFirstChild("Props") and ship.Props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
		local face = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
		local shipHub
		for _, m in ipairs(s.mounts) do
			if m.clone.Parent and m.clone.Parent.Name == "RotationPart" then shipHub = m.clone.Parent end
		end
		local modelHub
		for _, p in ipairs(s.model:GetChildren()) do
			if p:IsA("MeshPart") and Slots.socketFor(Slots.SHIP.Wheel, p.Name) == "RotationPart" then modelHub = p end
		end
		if face and shipHub and modelHub and s.faceSnapshot then
			local rig = s.model.FaceRig
			local movedAny = false
			for _, part in ipairs(face:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and s.faceSnapshot[part] and (part.CFrame.Position - s.faceSnapshot[part].Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 then
					movedAny = true
				end
			end
			if movedAny or math.abs(face:GetScale() - (s.faceScale or face:GetScale())) > 1e-4 then
				rig:ScaleTo(face:GetScale())
				local map = modelHub:GetPivot() * shipHub:GetPivot():Inverse()
				for _, part in ipairs(face:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						local path = part:GetFullName():sub(#face:GetFullName() + 2)
						local target = rig
						for seg in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do target = target and target:FindFirstChild(seg) end
						if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then target.CFrame = map * part.CFrame end
					end
				end
				table.insert(changes, "face moved")
			end
		end
	end
	-- the board's text plane goes back onto the model's BoardTextPlane
	if slot == "Board" and s.planeExpected then
		local plane = s.planeExpected.plane
		if plane.Parent and ((plane.CFrame.Position - s.planeExpected.cf.Position).Magnitude > 1e-4 or (plane.Size - s.planeExpected.size).Magnitude > 1e-4) then
			local modelPlane = s.model:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane", true)
			local piece = modelPlane and modelPlane.Parent
			local socket = plane.Parent
			if modelPlane and piece and piece:IsA("BasePart") then
				local pieceFrame = piece.CFrame * piece.PivotOffset
				modelPlane.CFrame = pieceFrame * socket.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(plane.CFrame)
				modelPlane.Size = plane.Size
				table.insert(changes, "name plane moved")
			end
		end
	end
	return changes
end

-- the preview pieces of a slot (to select them on the ship)
function Preview.clones(slot)
	local out = {}
	local s = state.slots[slot]
	for _, m in ipairs(s and s.mounts or {}) do
		if m.clone.Parent then table.insert(out, m.clone) end
	end
	return out
end

-- the camera on the slot's first item
function Preview.focus(slot, index)
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return end
	local target
	if Slots.SHIP[slot].texture then
		for _, part in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SkinSurface_" .. slot)) do
			if part:IsDescendantOf(ship) then target = part break end
		end
	else
		local items = SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship)
		target = items[((index or 1) - 1) % math.max(#items, 1) + 1]
	end
	if not target then return 0 end
	local cf, size
	if target:IsA("Model") or target:IsA("Folder") then
		if target:IsA("Model") then
			cf, size = target:GetBoundingBox()
		else
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			local parts = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end end
			cf = parts[1] and parts[1].CFrame or ship:GetPivot()
			size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
			m:Destroy()
		end
	else
		cf, size = target.CFrame, target.Size
	end
	-- look from outside the ship, level-ish: the item's direction from the hull centre,
	-- flattened; an item on the centre line (wheel, anchor) is seen from astern-and-aside
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	local hcf = hull and hull.CFrame or ship:GetPivot()
	local out = cf.Position - hcf.Position
	out = out - out:Dot(hcf.UpVector) * hcf.UpVector
	local side = out:Dot(hcf.RightVector)
	if math.abs(side) < 3 then
		out = -hcf.LookVector * 0.8 + hcf.RightVector * 0.6
	else
		out = hcf.RightVector * math.sign(side) - hcf.LookVector * 0.35
	end
	-- items with a face that matters are seen from the front: the board from its
	-- text plane's Front, the wheel from the hub toward Billy's face
	if slot == "Board" then
		local plane = target:FindFirstChild("BoardTextPlane")
		if plane then
			cf = plane.CFrame
			out = plane.CFrame.LookVector
		end
	elseif slot == "Wheel" then
		local faces = ship:FindFirstChild("Props") and ship.Props:FindFirstChild("Faces")
		local face = faces and faces:FindFirstChild("ShipWheelFace")
		local hub = target:FindFirstChild("RotationPart")
		if face and hub then
			local d = face:GetPivot().Position - hub.Position
			if d.Magnitude > 1e-3 then out = d.Unit end
		end
	end
	local dist = math.clamp(size.Magnitude * 2.2, 8, 60)
	local eye = cf.Position + (out.Unit + hcf.UpVector * 0.3).Unit * dist
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(eye, cf.Position)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(cf.Position)
	if Slots.SHIP[slot].texture then return 1 end
	return #SkinSockets.slots[slot].items(ship)
end

-- the whole ship in view, seen the way the Studio camera already looks: only the distance
-- and the point it looks at change. Framed on the ship's own visible parts: the wind-streak
-- VFX parts float up to ~300 studs away (the full bounding box was 466 studs long, so the
-- camera ended far out over the baseplate).
local FRAME_RADIUS = 110 -- studs from the hull; the flag top is ~90
function Preview.focusShip()
	local ship = Preview.ship()
	if not ship then return end
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	local c = (hull and hull:IsA("BasePart")) and hull.Position or ship:GetPivot().Position
	local lo, hi
	for _, p in ipairs(ship:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.99 and (p.Position - c).Magnitude < FRAME_RADIUS then
			local e = p.Size / 2
			lo = lo and lo:Min(p.Position - e) or (p.Position - e)
			hi = hi and hi:Max(p.Position + e) or (p.Position + e)
		end
	end
	local centre = lo and (lo + hi) / 2 or c
	local radius = lo and math.max((hi - lo).Magnitude / 2, 10) or 40
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
	-- far enough for the ship's sphere to fit the narrower of the two view angles
	local vfov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local hfov = math.atan(math.tan(vfov) * math.max(vp.X, 1) / math.max(vp.Y, 1))
	local dist = radius / math.sin(math.min(vfov, hfov)) * 0.85
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centre - look * dist, centre)
	cam.Focus = CFrame.new(centre)
end

-- live updates ------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Preview.stopLive()
	for _, c in ipairs(state.liveConns) do c:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(state.liveConns)
	table.clear(state.liveSkins)
end

-- re-run `onChange` (coalesced to one per frame) whenever any watched model changes
function Preview.watch(models, onChange)
	Preview.stopLive()
	local function queue()
		if state.pending then return end
		state.pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			state.pending = false
			onChange()
		end)
	end
	local WATCH = { CFrame = true, PivotOffset = true, Size = true, Color = true, Transparency = true,
		Brightness = true, Range = true, Enabled = true, TextureID = true }
	local function hook(inst)
		table.insert(state.liveConns, inst.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if WATCH[prop] or inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or inst:IsA("Light") or inst:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then queue() end
		end))
	end
	for _, model in ipairs(models) do
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.AttributeChanged:Connect(queue))
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) hook(d) queue() end))
		table.insert(state.liveConns, model.DescendantRemoving:Connect(queue))
		if model:IsA("BasePart") then hook(model) end
		for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Light") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then hook(d) end
		end
	end
end

function Preview.shownKey(slot)
	return state.slots[slot] and state.slots[slot].key
end

return Preview

	local out = {}

		table.insert(out[s.slot], s)
	end
	return out

local function find(slot, key)
	for _, s in ipairs(bySlot()[slot] or {}) do

	end
	return nil
end

-- dress the ship with the current set (+ body paint)
local function apply()
	Preview.stopLive()
	Preview.clearAll()
	local models, shown = {}, 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(Slots.ORDER) do
		local key = tab.set[slot]
		local skin = key and key ~= "Default" and find(slot, key)
		if skin then
			local r = ShipSkins.inspect(skin, Website.get(skin.key, skin.slot) or nil)
			if r.plan and Preview.show(skin, r.plan) then
				shown += 1
				table.insert(models, skin.model)
			end
		end
	end
	if tab.body and tab.theme then
		local palette = Preview.paletteFor(tab.theme, ShipSkins.catalogData())
		Preview.paint(palette)
	else
		Preview.paint(nil)
	end
	-- edits to any shown model re-dress the ship on the next frame
	Preview.watch(models, function()
		if ctx.active() then apply() end
	end)
	return shown
end

			local best, bestN = NO_TIER, 0

local function nudge(skin, piece, t, label)
	-- moving the MOUNTED piece by t (socket space) = pivot P becomes P * t⁻¹
	local ok, err = recorded(label .. " " .. piece.Name, function()
		Preview.setPivot(piece, piece.PivotOffset * t:Inverse())
	end)
	if not ok then ctx.toast(tostring(err), "bad") end
end

local function rescale(piece, factor)
	recorded("Scale " .. piece.Name, function()
		local pivotWorld = piece.CFrame * piece.PivotOffset
		piece.Size = piece.Size * factor
		-- keep the pivot on the same spot of the (now bigger / smaller) mesh
		piece.PivotOffset = CFrame.new(piece.PivotOffset.Position * factor) * piece.PivotOffset.Rotation
		piece.CFrame = pivotWorld * piece.PivotOffset:Inverse()
		local native = piece:GetAttribute("NativeSize")
		if typeof(native) == "Vector3" and native.X > 0 then piece:SetAttribute("FitScale", piece.Size / native) end
		if piece:GetAttribute("FitOffset") ~= nil then piece:SetAttribute("FitOffset", piece.PivotOffset.Position) end
	end)
end
