-- DRAGGING: one host (the panel root) forwards mouse moves to the slider being dragged;
-- nothing is connected per slider, and nothing runs when no one drags
local activeDrag = nil
function Theme.bindDragHost(host)
	host.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if activeDrag and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then activeDrag(input.Position.X) end
	end)
	host.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then activeDrag = nil end
	end)
end

-- a 0..1 slider over a gradient; onChange(value) while dragging / on click.
-- returns the frame and set(value) (moves the knob without calling onChange)
function Theme.slider(label, value, gradient, onChange, order)
	local f = new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), LayoutOrder = order or 0 })
	Theme.text(label, { TextColor3 = Theme.color.dim, TextSize = 12, Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 1, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None }).Parent = f
	local track = new("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0.5, -7), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0, 14) },
		{ Theme.corner(7), new("UIGradient", { Color = gradient }), Theme.stroke(Theme.color.cardStroke) })
	local knob = new("Frame", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(value, 0, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0 },
		{ Theme.corner(8), Theme.stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 2) })
	knob.Parent = track
	track.Parent = f
	local function set(v) knob.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(v, 0, 1), 0, 0.5, 0) end
	local function fromX(x)
		local v = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		set(v)
		onChange(v)
	end
	track.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(x)
		activeDrag = fromX
		fromX(x)
	end)
	track.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() activeDrag = nil end)
	return f, set, track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
end

function Theme.hex(c)
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

-- "255, 200, 105", "255 200 105" or "#FFC869" -> Color3, or nil
function Theme.parseColor(s)
	s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	local hex = s:match("^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$")
	if hex then
		return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16))
	end
	local r, g, b = s:match("^(%d+)[,%s]+(%d+)[,%s]+(%d+)$")
	if r then
		return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(r), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(g), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(b), 0, 255))
	end
	return nil
end

-- a 0..255 colour as "255, 200, 105"
function Theme.rgb(c)
	return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

return Theme
modules.ToolSkins:
--[[
	ToolSkins — sword / flintlock / bucket skins in the PVP&NPC ASSETS place.

	The designer's model (tagged SwordSkin / FlintlockSkin / BucketSkin) is already
	the shop's shape: a Model named with the key holding ONE MeshPart, plus the
	mount attributes ToolSkinMount reads. Approve copies it into
	ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins.<Tool>.<Key> — a Package since 2026-09-28, so the
	Lobby, Arena and Shipyard all pick it up from one Publish Package — and stamps
	what the shop reads off the model: Tier and Exclusive (from the website),
	Shown (the website's shop name), Icon (kept from the old entry).
]]

local ChangeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Slots = require(script.Parent.Slots)
local Util = require(script.Parent.Util)

local ToolSkins = {}

local SHOP_ATTRS = { Tier = true, Exclusive = true, Icon = true, Shown = true }

function ToolSkins.available()
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		if #CollectionService:GetTagged(Slots.TOOL[tool].tag) > 0 then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function ToolSkins.root()
	return ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ToolSkins")
end

function ToolSkins.scan()
	local out = {}
	for _, tool in ipairs(Slots.TOOL_ORDER) do
		local list = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(Slots.TOOL[tool].tag)) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				table.insert(list, { slot = tool, key = m.Name, model = m, kind = "tool" })
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.key:lower() < b.key:lower() end)
		for _, s in ipairs(list) do table.insert(out, s) end
	end
	return out
end

local function meshOf(model)
	local found
	local count = 0
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("MeshPart") then
			count += 1
			found = found or d
		end
	end
	return found, count
end

-- what the shop entry would carry: the designer's attributes + the shop's
local function wantedAttributes(skin, webRow, current)
	local a = {}
	for k, v in pairs(skin.model:GetAttributes()) do
		if k ~= "RBX_ReimportId" and not SHOP_ATTRS[k] then a[k] = v end
	end
	local tier = webRow and webRow.tier and Slots.TIERS[webRow.tier]
	a.Tier = tier or (current and current:GetAttribute("Tier")) or "Common"
	if webRow and webRow.merch then
		a.Exclusive = webRow.exclusive == true or nil
	elseif current then
		a.Exclusive = current:GetAttribute("Exclusive")
	end
	local icon = current and current:GetAttribute("Icon")
	if icon ~= nil then a.Icon = icon end
	local shown = webRow and type(webRow.shop_name) == "string" and #webRow.shop_name > 0 and webRow.shop_name
	a.Shown = shown or (current and current:GetAttribute("Shown")) or nil
	return a
end

function ToolSkins.inspect(skin, webRow)
	local def = Slots.TOOL[skin.slot]
	local model = skin.model
	local checks = {}
	local function check(level, text, fix) table.insert(checks, { level = level, text = text, fix = fix }) end

	if skin.key:find("[%.%s/]") then
		check("bad", "The name '" .. skin.key .. "' has a space, dot or slash — it cannot be a shop key.")
	elseif not skin.key:match("^" .. skin.slot .. "_") then
		check("warn", "Name should be " .. skin.slot .. "_<Name> (the naming guide, docs/notes/economy/skin-naming.md).")
	end
	local mesh, count = meshOf(model)
	if not mesh then
		check("bad", "No MeshPart — a tool skin is one mesh.")
	else
		if count > 1 then check("warn", count .. " MeshParts — the game mounts only the first (" .. mesh.Name .. ").") end
		if not Util.assetId(mesh.MeshId) then check("bad", "The mesh has no MeshId.") end
		if mesh.TextureID == "" and not mesh:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance") then
			check("warn", "No texture and no SurfaceAppearance — it will be plain grey.")
		end
	end
	local mountOk = true
	for attr, kind in pairs(def.required) do
		local v = model:GetAttribute(attr)
		if v == nil then
			mountOk = false
			check("bad", "Missing mount attribute " .. attr .. " (" .. kind .. ") — set it on the model (the SkinRoom pad shows the fit).")
		elseif typeof(v) ~= kind then
			mountOk = false
			check("bad", attr .. " must be a " .. kind .. " (it is a " .. typeof(v) .. ").")
		end
	end
	for attr, kind in pairs(def.optional) do
		local v = model:GetAttribute(attr)
		if v ~= nil and typeof(v) ~= kind then
			mountOk = false
			check("bad", attr .. " must be a " .. kind .. ".")
		end
	end
	if def.check then
		local why = def.check(model)
		if why then
			mountOk = false
			check("bad", why)
		end
	end
	if mountOk then check("ok", "Mount attributes set for a " .. skin.slot:lower() .. ".") end

	local root = ToolSkins.root()
	local folder = root and root:FindFirstChild(skin.slot)
	local current = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(skin.key)
	if not root then
		check("bad", "No ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins in this place — insert the ToolSkins Package here first (Toolbox → My Packages).")
	end

	local want = wantedAttributes(skin, webRow, current)
	local diffs = {}
	if current then
		local cm = meshOf(current)
		if not (cm and mesh and cm.MeshId == mesh.MeshId) then table.insert(diffs, "mesh changed") end
		if cm and mesh and cm.TextureID ~= mesh.TextureID then table.insert(diffs, "texture changed") end
		if cm and mesh and (cm.Size - mesh.Size).Magnitude > 1e-3 then table.insert(diffs, "size changed") end
		for k, v in pairs(want) do
			if current:GetAttribute(k) ~= v then table.insert(diffs, k .. ": " .. tostring(current:GetAttribute(k)) .. " → " .. tostring(v)) end
		end
		for k in pairs(current:GetAttributes()) do
			if want[k] == nil and k ~= "RBX_ReimportId" then table.insert(diffs, k .. " removed") end
		end
	end
	local status = (not current) and "new" or (#diffs == 0 and "same" or "changed")

	local lines = { "ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins." .. skin.slot .. "." .. skin.key .. "  (Model + " .. (mesh and mesh.Name or "?") .. ")" }
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(want) do table.insert(keys, k) end
	table.sort(keys)
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do table.insert(lines, "  " .. k .. " = " .. tostring(want[k])) end

	local ok = true
	for _, c in ipairs(checks) do
		if c.level == "bad" then ok = false end
	end
	return { checks = checks, row = table.concat(lines, "\n"), status = status, diffs = current and diffs or nil, ok = ok, want = want }
end

function ToolSkins.approve(skin, result)
	if not result.ok then return false, "Fix the red checks first." end
	local root = ToolSkins.root()
	if not root then return false, "No ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins here." end
	local recording = ChangeHistoryService:TryBeginRecording("SailMeSkinsApproveTool", "Approve tool skin " .. skin.key)
	local folder = root:FindFirstChild(skin.slot)
	if not folder then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = skin.slot
		folder.Parent = root
	end
	local old = folder:FindFirstChild(skin.key)
	local copy = skin.model:Clone()
	for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
		for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(d)) do CollectionService:RemoveTag(d, t) end
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(copy)) do CollectionService:RemoveTag(copy, t) end
	for k in pairs(copy:GetAttributes()) do copy:SetAttribute(k, nil) end
	for k, v in pairs(result.want) do copy:SetAttribute(k, v) end
	copy.Name = skin.key
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	copy.Parent = folder
	if recording then ChangeHistoryService:FinishRecording(recording, Enum.FinishRecordingOperation.Commit) end
	return true, (old and "Updated " or "Added ") .. skin.key .. " in ToolSkins." .. skin.slot
		.. ". Now right-click ReplicatedStorage.ToolSkins → Publish Package."
end

return ToolSkins
modules.Util:
--[[
	Util — formatting catalogue values as Luau source, and a brace matcher that
	understands strings and comments, so a row can be found and replaced inside the
	SkinCatalog module text without touching anything around it.
]]

local Util = {}

local function n6(x)
	local s = string.format("%.6f", x)
	if s == "-0.000000" then s = "0.000000" end
	return s
end
Util.n6 = n6

-- a number as the catalogue writes it: integers bare, everything else to 6 places
function Util.num(x)
	if x == math.floor(x) and math.abs(x) < 1e15 then return string.format("%d", x) end
	return n6(x)
end

function Util.cframe(cf)
	local c = { cf:GetComponents() }
	for i, v in ipairs(c) do c[i] = n6(v) end
	return "CFrame.new(" .. table.concat(c, ", ") .. ")"
end

function Util.vector3(v)
	return string.format("Vector3.new(%s, %s, %s)", n6(v.X), n6(v.Y), n6(v.Z))
end

function Util.color3(c)
	return string.format("Color3.fromRGB(%d, %d, %d)",
		math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

function Util.str(s)
	return string.format("%q", s)
end

function Util.isIdentifier(s)
	return s:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") ~= nil
end

-- the table key as it is written in source: Name or ["odd-name"]
function Util.keyExpr(k)
	if Util.isIdentifier(k) then return k end
	return "[" .. string.format("%q", k) .. "]"
end

function Util.assetId(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local id = s:match("(%d+)%s*$")
	return id and tonumber(id) or nil
end

-- index of the `}` that closes the `{` at `open`, skipping strings and comments
function Util.matchBrace(src, open)
	local depth = 0
	local i = open
	local n = #src
	while i <= n do
		local c = src:sub(i, i)
		if c == "-" and src:sub(i, i + 1) == "--" then
			local eq = src:match("^%-%-%[(=*)%[", i)
			if eq then
				local close = src:find("]" .. eq .. "]", i, true)
				i = close and (close + #eq + 2) or n + 1
			else
				local nl = src:find("\n", i, true)
				i = nl and nl + 1 or n + 1
			end
		elseif c == '"' or c == "'" then
			local j = i + 1
			while j <= n do
				local d = src:sub(j, j)
				if d == "\\" then
					j += 2
				elseif d == c then
					break
				else
					j += 1
				end
			end
			i = j + 1
		elseif c == "[" and src:match("^%[=*%[", i) then
			local eq = src:match("^%[(=*)%[", i)
			local close = src:find("]" .. eq .. "]", i, true)
			i = close and (close + #eq + 2) or n + 1
		else
			if c == "{" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == "}" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth == 0 then return i end
			end
			i += 1
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- rotation between two CFrames, in degrees
function Util.angleBetween(a, b)
	local rel = a.Rotation:Inverse() * b.Rotation
	local _, angle = rel:ToAxisAngle()
	return math.deg(math.abs(angle))
end

function Util.lower(s)
	return string.lower(s)
end

return Util
modules.Website:
--[[
	Website — asks the ZAAL team website whether each skin is approved and will be
	sold. One POST to /api/team/assets-list with the owner's agent token and the
	skin names (`names`, exact match; added in website 1.87.0). The token lives in
	this plugin's own settings on this machine — never in the place or the repo.

	Each answer row (merch items) carries: status, render_status, tier, exclusive,
	price, on_sale, item_id, product_id, shop_name, will_sell, will_sell_reason.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Website = {}

-- no dots: Studio stores "a.b" as "a_b" but GetSetting("a.b") then answers nil (2026-09-28),
-- so the token saved but the plugin never saw it
local TOKEN_KEY = "SailMeSkins_Token"
local URL_KEY = "SailMeSkins_Url"
local DEFAULT_URL = "https://team.zaalstudio.com"

local pluginRef
local cache = {} -- lower-case name -> row (or false when the site has no such asset)
-- lower-case "name|slot" -> row. One name can be filed several times: the render image always
-- shares the skin's name, and a model can be filed under the wrong slot too (GrapeFizzCannon
-- under Objects/Ship/Anchor as well as Cannon). A tier change BY NAME is then refused as
-- ambiguous, so writes send the id of the row filed under the skin's own slot.
local bySlot = {}
local library = nil -- Website.loadLibrary(): every object, for near-name hints

function Website.init(plugin)
	pluginRef = plugin
end

function Website.token()
	local t = pluginRef:GetSetting(TOKEN_KEY)
	return (type(t) == "string" and #t > 0) and t or nil
end

function Website.setToken(t)
	pluginRef:SetSetting(TOKEN_KEY, (t and #t > 0) and t or nil)
	table.clear(cache)
	table.clear(bySlot)
end

function Website.url()
	local u = pluginRef:GetSetting(URL_KEY)
	return (type(u) == "string" and #u > 0) and u or DEFAULT_URL
end

function Website.setUrl(u)
	pluginRef:SetSetting(URL_KEY, (u and #u > 0) and u or nil)
	table.clear(cache)
	table.clear(bySlot)
end

function Website.clear()
	table.clear(cache)
	table.clear(bySlot)
	library = nil
end

local function forget(name)
	cache[name:lower()] = nil
	local prefix = name:lower() .. "|"
	for k in pairs(bySlot) do
		if k:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then bySlot[k] = nil end
	end
end

-- the cached row for a name: a table, false (not on the website) or nil (not asked yet).
-- With a slot, the row filed under that slot wins over a same-named one filed elsewhere.
function Website.get(name, slot)
	local row = cache[name:lower()]
	if row and slot then return bySlot[name:lower() .. "|" .. slot:lower()] or row end
	return row
end

-- what a write names the asset by: the row's id when known (unambiguous), else the name
local function assetRef(name, slot)
	local row = Website.get(name, slot)
	return type(row) == "table" and row.id or name
end

-- ask for every name not cached yet; returns ok, message
function Website.fetch(names)
	local token = Website.token()
	if not token then return false, "No website token — open Settings and paste your agent token." end
	local want = {}
	for _, n in ipairs(names) do
		if cache[n:lower()] == nil then table.insert(want, n) end
	end
	if #want == 0 then return true, nil end
	local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ token = token, names = want, limit = 2000 })
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = Website.url() .. "/api/team/assets-list",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = body,
		})
	end)
	if not ok then return false, "Could not reach the website: " .. tostring(res) end
	if res.StatusCode == 401 or res.StatusCode == 403 then
		return false, "The website refused the token (" .. res.StatusCode .. "). Make a new one: Dashboard → Agent token."
	end
	if not res.Success then return false, "Website answered " .. res.StatusCode .. ": " .. tostring(res.Body):sub(1, 200) end
	local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
	if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" or not data.success then
		return false, "Unexpected website answer: " .. tostring(res.Body):sub(1, 200)
	end
	for _, n in ipairs(want) do cache[n:lower()] = false end
	for _, a in ipairs(data.assets or {}) do
		-- a skin's own asset, not its render image (renders are separate image assets)
		if type(a.name) == "string" and a.kind ~= "image" then
			local key = a.name:lower()
			if not cache[key] then cache[key] = a end -- by name alone: the first row
			if type(a.slot) == "string" then bySlot[key .. "|" .. a.slot:lower()] = a end
		end
	end
	-- a name the website does not have: load the whole library once, so the panel can name
	-- the website item it most likely is (Silver Storm for SilverStormWheel)
	local missing = false
	for _, n in ipairs(want) do
		if cache[n:lower()] == false then missing = true end
	end
	if missing and not library then Website.loadLibrary() end
	return true, nil
end

-- the library's objects (no images), once per session: { name, path, slot }
function Website.loadLibrary()
	local token = Website.token()
	if not token then return end
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = Website.url() .. "/api/team/assets-list",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ token = token, limit = 2000 }),
		})
	end)
	if not (ok and res.Success) then return end
	local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
	if not (okJson and type(data) == "table" and data.success) then return end
	library = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(data.assets or {}) do
		if type(a.name) == "string" and a.kind ~= "image" then
			local path = tostring(a.path or "")
			local last = path:match("([^/]+)$")
			table.insert(library, { name = a.name, path = path, slot = a.slot or (last and (last:gsub("^%s+", ""))) })
		end
	end
end

local function norm(s) return (s:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end

-- edit distance, for "MidNightLanetrn" ~ "MidNightLantern"
local function distance(a, b)
	if math.abs(#a - #b) > 4 then return 99 end
	local prev = {}
	for j = 0, #b do prev[j] = j end
	for i = 1, #a do
		local cur = { [0] = i }
		for j = 1, #b do
			cur[j] = math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + (a:sub(i, i) == b:sub(j, j) and 0 or 1))
		end
		prev = cur
	end
	return prev[#b]
end

-- the website item this skin most likely is, when its name is not there: same slot, and the
-- names equal once spaces / capitals / the slot word are ignored, one inside the other, or a
-- typo apart. nil when nothing is close (or the library could not be read).
function Website.nearName(name, slot)
	if not library then return nil end
	local n, s = norm(name), slot and norm(slot) or ""
	local bare = (#s > 0 and n:sub(-#s) == s) and n:sub(1, #n - #s) or n
	local best, bestScore = nil, 99
	for _, a in ipairs(library) do
		if not slot or norm(a.slot or "") == s then
			local m = norm(a.name)
			local score
			if m == n or m == bare or m .. s == n then
				score = 0
			elseif (#m >= 5 and n:find(m, 1, true)) or (#n >= 5 and m:find(n, 1, true)) then
				score = 1
			else
				local dist = distance(m, n)
				score = dist <= 3 and (1 + dist) or 99
			end
			if score < bestScore then best, bestScore = a, score end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- change a skin's tier (and/or Exclusive) on the website AND in the game (website 1.88.0+):
-- `assets-tier` with game = true moves the Robux product and writes itemTier[<game key>]
-- into the game's economy config, recorded in the Pricing page's history.
-- tier: "common" | "rare" | "epic" | "legendary" (or nil to leave it); returns ok, message
function Website.setTier(name, tier, exclusive, slot)
	local token = Website.token()
	if not token then return false, "No website token — open Settings." end
	local okList, listErr = Website.fetch({ name })
	if not okList then return false, listErr end
	local item = { asset = assetRef(name, slot) }
	if tier then item.tier = tier end
	if exclusive ~= nil then item.exclusive = exclusive end
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = Website.url() .. "/api/team/assets-tier",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			-- price_from_formula (website 1.91.0): an item with no price yet goes on sale at the
			-- tier price for its slot, as the Merch page's tier pick does; a priced one keeps its price
			Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ token = token, items = { item }, game = true, price_from_formula = true }),
		})
	end)
	if not ok then return false, "Could not reach the website: " .. tostring(res) end
	local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
	if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" then return false, "Website answered " .. res.StatusCode end
	if not data.success then return false, tostring(data.error or data.message or ("Website answered " .. res.StatusCode)) end
	forget(name)
	local r = data.results and data.results[1] or {}
	if r.status == "failed" then
		-- the website's reason is in `message` (it was read from error / reason, which it never
		-- sends, so every refusal showed as "The website refused the change")
		local why = tostring(r.message or r.error or r.reason or "The website refused the change.")
		if why:find("Not on sale", 1, true) then
			why ..= " The website needs 1.91.0 to price it from the tier — or give it a price on the Merch page, or use Make exclusive."
		end
		return false, why
	end
	local parts = { "Website tier " .. tostring(r.status or "updated") }
	if data.game_published then
		table.insert(parts, "game gold tier published")
	elseif data.game_error then
		table.insert(parts, "game tier NOT published: " .. tostring(data.game_error))
	elseif r.game and r.game.skipped then
		table.insert(parts, "game tier skipped: " .. tostring(r.game.skipped))
	elseif data.game_message then
		table.insert(parts, tostring(data.game_message))
	end
	if data.game_warning then table.insert(parts, "warning: " .. tostring(data.game_warning)) end
	return data.game_error == nil, table.concat(parts, " · ")
end

-- one tier for many skins in ONE call (website max 200) and ONE game-config publish — the
-- Preview tab's theme tier. dryRun = check only, write nothing. returns ok, data | message;
-- data = { updated, would_update, unchanged, failed, results = { {asset, status, from, to, message} },
--          game_published, game_changed, game_would_publish, game_error, game_message, game_warning }
-- skins = { { key, slot }, ... } (the scan's skins)
function Website.setTiers(skins, tier, dryRun)
	local token = Website.token()
	if not token then return false, "No website token — open Settings." end
	if #skins == 0 then return false, "No skins in this theme." end
	if #skins > 200 then return false, "More than 200 skins — the website takes 200 per change." end
	local names = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(skins) do table.insert(names, s.key) end
	-- the ids come from the list; without them a name filed twice is refused as ambiguous
	local okList, listErr = Website.fetch(names)
	if not okList then return false, listErr end
	local items, nameOf = {}, {}
	for _, s in ipairs(skins) do
		local ref = assetRef(s.key, s.slot)
		nameOf[ref] = s.key
		table.insert(items, { asset = ref, tier = tier })
	end
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = Website.url() .. "/api/team/assets-tier",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ token = token, items = items, game = true, dry_run = dryRun == true, price_from_formula = true }),
		})
	end)
	if not ok then return false, "Could not reach the website: " .. tostring(res) end
	local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
	if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" then return false, "Website answered " .. res.StatusCode end
	if not data.success then return false, tostring(data.error or data.message or ("Website answered " .. res.StatusCode)) end
	-- answers name the asset as sent (an id): show the skin's name
	for _, r in ipairs(data.results or {}) do
		if nameOf[r.asset] then r.asset = nameOf[r.asset] end
	end
	if not dryRun then
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do forget(n) end
	end
	return true, data
end

-- send the skin back to its artist as "Needs fix" (website 1.90.0 `assets-review`): the same
-- review the Assets page records — status needs_fix, the comment, a Discord note and the fix on
-- the asset's task on the board. returns ok, message (the website says what it did on the board)
function Website.needsFix(name, slot, comment)
	local token = Website.token()
	if not token then return false, "No website token — open Settings." end
	if type(comment) ~= "string" or comment:match("^%s*$") then return false, "Write what needs fixing first." end
	local okList, listErr = Website.fetch({ name })
	if not okList then return false, listErr end
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:RequestAsync({
			Url = Website.url() .. "/api/team/assets-review",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
			Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({ token = token, asset = assetRef(name, slot), decision = "needs_fix", comment = comment }),
		})
	end)
	if not ok then return false, "Could not reach the website: " .. tostring(res) end
	local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
	if not okJson or type(data) ~= "table" then return false, "Website answered " .. res.StatusCode end
	if not data.success then return false, tostring(data.error or data.message or ("Website answered " .. res.StatusCode)) end
	forget(name)
	return true, tostring(data.message or "Sent back for a fix.")
end

-- a plain-words summary for the panel: { level = "ok"|"warn"|"bad", lines = {...} }
function Website.summary(row, expectedItemId, skin)
	if row == nil then return { level = "warn", lines = { "Website not checked yet." } } end
	if row == false then
		local near = skin and Website.nearName(skin.key, skin.slot)
		if near then
			return { level = "bad", lines = {
				"Not on the website under this name — but the website has '" .. near.name .. "' (" .. near.path .. ").",
				"They must match exactly: the website, the shop and its Roblox product find a skin by its name. Rename one of them.",
			} }
		end
		return { level = "warn", lines = { "Not on the website — it stays hidden in the shop until it is uploaded, approved and priced." } }
	end
	local lines = {}
	local level = "ok"
	local function worse(l)
		if l == "bad" or (l == "warn" and level == "ok") then level = l end
	end
	table.insert(lines, "Asset: " .. tostring(row.status) .. (row.render_status and ("  ·  render: " .. row.render_status) or "  ·  no render linked"))
	if row.status ~= "approved" then worse("warn") end
	if row.merch then
		local tier = row.tier and (row.tier:sub(1, 1):upper() .. row.tier:sub(2)) or "no tier"
		table.insert(lines, "Tier: " .. tier .. (row.exclusive and "  ·  Exclusive (pass / bundle only)" or "")
			.. (row.price and ("  ·  " .. row.price .. " gold") or ""))
		if row.shop_name and #row.shop_name > 0 then table.insert(lines, "Shop name: " .. row.shop_name) end
		if row.product_id then table.insert(lines, "Roblox product: " .. tostring(row.product_id)) end
		if row.will_sell == true then
			table.insert(lines, "Will sell: yes — " .. tostring(row.will_sell_reason or ""))
		elseif row.will_sell == false then
			table.insert(lines, "Will sell: no — " .. tostring(row.will_sell_reason or ""))
			worse("warn")
		else
			table.insert(lines, "Will sell: unknown (the website could not read its product tables)")
			worse("warn")
		end
		if expectedItemId and row.item_id and row.item_id ~= expectedItemId then
			table.insert(lines, "KEY MISMATCH: the website sells it as " .. row.item_id .. " but the game key is "
				.. expectedItemId .. " — the shop would never list it. Rename one of them.")
			worse("bad")
		end
	else
		table.insert(lines, "Not in a sellable folder on the website (no tier / price).")
		worse("warn")
	end
	return { level = level, lines = lines }
end

return Website
modules.ShipNameText:
--[[
	ShipNameText — draws a ship's name as curved per-letter text on a board's
	BoardTextPlane (2026-09-28, moved out of ShipNameBoardService).

	One copy, used by ShipNameBoardService (Arena + Shipyard) and by the skin
	plugin's ship preview, so the preview shows exactly the board players see.

	style = { font = Font, color = Color3, outline = Color3, thick = number (px, 0 = none),
	          scale = number (letter size multiplier) }
	styleFromBoard(board) reads it off the Board part's Name* attributes (set by
	SkinService from a board skin's catalog `text` row); missing = the defaults.
]]

local ShipNameText = {}

ShipNameText.FONT = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy) -- chunky pirate-sign look
ShipNameText.COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90) -- warm gold
ShipNameText.OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(45, 25, 8)
ShipNameText.THICK = 2.5
ShipNameText.MAX_CHARS = 20

local BRIGHTNESS = 2.5 -- SurfaceGui glow push (needs Bloom in Lighting to bloom)
local PIXELS_PER_STUD = 60
local ARC_RADIUS_FRAC = 1.15 -- arc radius as a fraction of canvas width (bigger = flatter)
local WIDTH_FRAC = 0.76 -- name fits inside this fraction of the board width
local LETTER_MAX_W = 52 -- px, shrinks automatically for long names
local LETTER_MAX_SHORT = 68 -- px cap for short names (≤8 chars) so they fill the board
local LETTER_ASPECT = 1.35 -- height / width
local Y_CENTER_FRAC = 0.50 -- letter-row center as fraction of board height (0 = top)

-- the board skin's text style, off the Board part's Name* attributes
function ShipNameText.styleFromBoard(board)
	local font = ShipNameText.FONT
	local family = board:GetAttribute("NameFont")
	if type(family) == "string" and #family > 0 then
		local weight = Enum.FontWeight.Regular
		local style = Enum.FontStyle.Normal
		for _, w in Enum.FontWeight:GetEnumItems() do
			if w.Name == board:GetAttribute("NameFontWeight") then weight = w end
		end
		for _, s in Enum.FontStyle:GetEnumItems() do
			if s.Name == board:GetAttribute("NameFontStyle") then style = s end
		end
		font = Font.new(family, weight, style)
	end
	local color = board:GetAttribute("NameColor")
	local outline = board:GetAttribute("NameOutlineColor")
	local thick = board:GetAttribute("NameOutlineThickness")
	local scale = board:GetAttribute("NameScale")
	return {
		font = font,
		color = typeof(color) == "Color3" and color or ShipNameText.COLOR,
		outline = typeof(outline) == "Color3" and outline or ShipNameText.OUTLINE,
		thick = (type(thick) == "number" and thick >= 0) and thick or ShipNameText.THICK,
		scale = (type(scale) == "number" and scale > 0) and scale or 1,
	}
end

-- a new SurfaceGui named ShipNameGui drawing `name` for a plane of `planeSize`
-- (unparented; the caller parents it, or sets Adornee). nil for an empty name.
function ShipNameText.build(planeSize, name, style, face)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or #name == 0 then return nil end
	name = name:upper():sub(1, ShipNameText.MAX_CHARS)

	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Name = "ShipNameGui"
	gui.Face = face or Enum.NormalId.Front
	gui.PixelsPerStud = PIXELS_PER_STUD
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.LightInfluence = 0
	gui.Brightness = BRIGHTNESS
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false

	local canvasW = planeSize.X * PIXELS_PER_STUD
	local canvasH = planeSize.Y * PIXELS_PER_STUD

	local n = #name
	local maxW = (n <= 8) and LETTER_MAX_SHORT or LETTER_MAX_W
	local letterW = math.min(maxW, (canvasW * WIDTH_FRAC) / n) * style.scale
	local letterH = letterW * LETTER_ASPECT
	local spacing = letterW * 0.98
	local radius = canvasW * ARC_RADIUS_FRAC
	local anglePer = spacing / radius -- radians between letter centers
	-- longer names curve further down at the edges; lift the row by half
	-- that drop so the VISUAL center stays put for any name length
	local maxTheta = ((n - 1) / 2) * anglePer
	local arcDrop = radius * (1 - math.cos(maxTheta))
	local cx = canvasW / 2
	local cy = canvasH * Y_CENTER_FRAC - arcDrop / 2

	for i = 1, n do
		local ch = name:sub(i, i)
		if ch ~= " " then
			local theta = (i - (n + 1) / 2) * anglePer
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Name = "L" .. i
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
				cx + math.sin(theta) * radius,
				cy + radius - math.cos(theta) * radius
			)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(letterW + 6, letterH)
			label.Rotation = math.deg(theta)
			label.Text = ch
			label.FontFace = style.font
			label.TextScaled = true
			label.TextColor3 = style.color
			if style.thick > 0 then
				local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				stroke.Thickness = style.thick
				stroke.Color = style.outline
				stroke.Parent = label
			end
			label.Parent = gui
		end
	end
	return gui
end

return ShipNameText
modules.SkinSockets:
--[[
	SkinSockets — WHERE each ship skin slot's pieces go (2026-09-28).

	Moved out of SkinService verbatim so that three things share ONE copy: the
	Arena's SkinService, the Shipyard's SkinService, and the skin plugin's ship
	preview (tools/skin-plugin). A preview built on anything else could disagree
	with the game about an offset — which is exactly what it exists to catch.

	Per slot: items(ship), sockets(item), hideParts(item), and optionally
	targetCF(socketName, sockets, entry) and postMount(socketName, sockets, mesh).
	The per-skin extras (wheel face, lantern candle rig, board text) stay in
	SkinService, which adds them as MESH_SLOTS.<Slot>.applyExtras.
	Pure geometry: no state, no yields, nothing per frame.
]]

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- anchor's special mount frame: world-upright, X along the prototype
-- RotationPart bar (the anchor BasePart's own local frame is rotated —
-- up = +X — so the socket CFrame can't be used directly)
-- SHIP-relative up, not world up (2026-07-24): Arena ships are dressed
-- while frozen in their tilted underwater breach pose — world-up
-- mounting baked that tilt's inverse into the welds (leaning anchor
-- once the ship leveled out). Hull's UpVector is pose-independent.
local function anchorUp(handle)
	local node = handle
	while node and node ~= workspace do
		if node:IsA("Model") and CollectionService:HasTag(node, "Ship") then
			local hull = node:FindFirstChild("Hull")
			if hull and hull:IsA("BasePart") then
				return hull.CFrame.UpVector
			end
			break
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return Vector3.yAxis
end

local function anchorTargetCF(position, handle)
	local up = anchorUp(handle)
	local axis = handle.CFrame.RightVector
	local flat = axis - axis:Dot(up) * up
	axis = flat.Magnitude > 1e-4 and flat.Unit or axis
	return CFrame.fromMatrix(position, axis, up)
end

-- all authored DefaultMesh visuals sitting on a slot's sockets (a socket
-- may carry SEVERAL DefaultMesh pieces — cannon body, wheels, details...)
local function defaultMeshesOf(sockets)
	local out = {}
	for _, socket in pairs(sockets) do
		for _, ch in ipairs(socket:GetChildren()) do
			if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch.Name == "DefaultMesh" then
				table.insert(out, ch)
			end
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- old capstan base socket → drum socket distance, identical on the 2026-07 and
-- 2026-09-04 pre-rig templates (measured 2026-09-08); see MESH_SLOTS.Anchor
local ANCHOR_BASE_UNDER_DRUM = 1.337

-- MESH SLOT DEFINITIONS -------------------------------------------------------
-- items(ship)   → list of item containers this slot dresses (a skin applies
--                 to EVERY item: both cannons, all lanterns, all doors)
-- sockets(item) → map SocketName → BasePart (weld target)
-- hideParts(item) → authored visual parts hidden while a skin is mounted
-- targetCF(socketName, sockets, entry) → optional world mount frame override

local function partsFolder(ship)
	local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
	local holder = hull and hull:FindFirstChild("PartHolder")
	return holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Parts")
end

-- CANONICAL RIG CONVENTION (2026-07-23): every station is an invisible
-- functional skeleton (collidable, massless, transparent) whose part names
-- ARE the socket names. All visuals — Default included — are DefaultMesh /
-- skin meshes welded onto those parts. The designer imports one mesh per
-- socket, origin at the socket point (see StationPrototypes + SkinCatalog).
local MESH_SLOTS = {}
MESH_SLOTS.Anchor = {
	items = function(ship)
		local stations = ship:FindFirstChild("Stations")
		local a = stations and stations:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
		if not a then -- old-tree fallback
			local parts = partsFolder(ship)
			a = parts and parts:FindFirstChild("Anchor")
		end
		return a and { a } or {}
	end,
	-- TEMPLATE RIG (2026-09-04, prop-anger-system.md): the station is five
	-- invisible template parts. The catalog keeps the old socket names, so
	-- they are mapped here; old-tree ships (BasePart/RotationPart) still
	-- resolve. LeftHand / RightHand / CenterPart are new sockets — no catalog
	-- piece targets them yet, and their authored meshes keep their own names
	-- (AnchorSpankClient finds "lefthand"/"righthand" by name), so they are
	-- hidden, never destroyed, and only while THEIR socket wears a piece.
	sockets = function(item)
		return {
			BasePart = item:FindFirstChild("BasePartTemplate") or item:FindFirstChild("BasePart"),
			RotationPart = item:FindFirstChild("RotationalPartTemplate") or item:FindFirstChild("RotationPart"),
			LeftHand = item:FindFirstChild("LeftHandTemplate"),
			RightHand = item:FindFirstChild("RightHandTemplate"),
			CenterPart = item:FindFirstChild("CenteralPartTemplate"),
		}
	end,
	hideParts = function(item)
		local sockets = MESH_SLOTS.Anchor.sockets(item)
		local out = defaultMeshesOf(sockets)
		for _, name in { "LeftHand", "RightHand", "CenterPart" } do
			local socket = sockets[name]
			if socket then
				for _, ch in socket:GetChildren() do
					if ch:IsA("BasePart") and not ch:GetAttribute("SkinMesh") then
						table.insert(out, ch)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return out
	end,
	targetCF = function(socketName, sockets, entry)
		local socket = sockets[socketName]
		-- upright frame with X along the bar. On the template rig the bar's X
		-- is the hand template's (the drum template stands on end — its X is
		-- the drum AXIS, which degenerates the frame); old-tree ships keep
		-- the RotationPart's X. Same sign on both (measured 2026-09-08).
		local bar = sockets.LeftHand or sockets.RotationPart
		local position = socket.Position
		if sockets.LeftHand then
			-- TEMPLATE RIG: the designer captures a piece's pivot on the template
			-- part's PIVOT (CFrame * PivotOffset — the hand templates pivot at the
			-- wrist end, 2.25 studs from their centre; base/drum/knob at their
			-- centre). Pieces authored on the rig (`rig = "template"` on the
			-- catalog entry) mount there. Entries without the flag predate the
			-- rig: their BasePart pivots were captured against the OLD base socket,
			-- ANCHOR_BASE_UNDER_DRUM below the (unmoved) drum socket, so that point
			-- is rebuilt for them. Hands/knob have no legacy pieces.
			position = socket:GetPivot().Position
			if socketName == "BasePart" and not (entry and entry.rig == "template") then
				position = sockets.RotationPart.Position - anchorUp(bar) * ANCHOR_BASE_UNDER_DRUM
			end
		end
		return anchorTargetCF(position, bar)
	end,
}
-- Outside anchor (2026-09-04, Shayan: "skinnable and changeable"). The
-- stand is a Model of two invisible template parts: StandTemplate (hull
-- weld + the DropMotor) and AnchorTemplate (drops on the motor, carries
-- the Chain_N links — those are RIG, not skin, so every skin keeps the
-- drop animation). Visible stand + anchor are DefaultMesh children.
MESH_SLOTS.OutsideAnchor = {
	items = function(ship)
		local stations = ship:FindFirstChild("Stations")
		local s = stations and stations:FindFirstChild("OutsideAnchorStand")

	end,
	sockets = function(item)
		return {
			StandTemplate = item:FindFirstChild("StandTemplate"),
			AnchorTemplate = item:FindFirstChild("AnchorTemplate"),
		}
	end,
	hideParts = function(item)

}
MESH_SLOTS.Wheel = {

MESH_SLOTS.Cannon = {
	items = function(ship)

		local cannons = stations and stations:FindFirstChild("Cannons")
		if not cannons then -- old-tree fallback
			local hull = ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
			local holder = hull and hull:FindFirstChild("PartHolder")
			cannons = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Cannons")
		end
		return cannons and cannons:GetChildren() or {}
	end,
	-- FACE TEMPLATES (2026-09-08, Shayan: "change the skin of faces with the
	-- cannon"): Faces holds three invisible template parts — OpenMouthTemplate,
	-- CloseMouthTemplate, TongueTemplate — each carrying its authored mesh
	-- under its OWN name (OpenMouth / CloseMouth / Tongue). Like the capstan's
	-- hands, those are hidden, never destroyed, and only while THEIR socket
	-- wears a piece, so a barrel-only skin keeps the authored mouth.
	-- CannonService toggles whichever mesh is active on each face socket.
	-- AIM (rig v2, 2026-09-09): AimTemplate is the small aiming knob on top of
	-- the barrel (rides RotationPart); its authored mesh is "Aim" — same
	-- hide-only rule as the faces.
	sockets = function(item)
		return {
			BasePart = item:FindFirstChild("BasePart"),
			RotationPart = item:FindFirstChild("RotationPart"),
			OpenMouth = item:FindFirstChild("OpenMouthTemplate", true),

		local sockets = MESH_SLOTS.Cannon.sockets(item)
		local out = defaultMeshesOf(sockets)
		for _, name in { "OpenMouth", "CloseMouth", "Tongue", "Aim" } do
			local socket = sockets[name]
			if socket then
				for _, ch in socket:GetChildren() do
					if ch:IsA("BasePart") and not ch:GetAttribute("SkinMesh") then
						table.insert(out, ch)
					end
				end

		return out
	end,
}
MESH_SLOTS.Lantern = {
	items = function(ship)
		local props = ship:FindFirstChild("Props")
		local f = (props and props:FindFirstChild("Lanterns"))
			or ship:FindFirstChild("Lantherns") -- old-tree fallback

	-- TEMPLATE RIG (2026-09-08, Shayan: "handle, base, glass and legs"): four
	-- invisible template parts sit on the lantern model beside UpperBasePart /
	-- LowerBasePart (which stay the functional skeleton: LifeMotor / SwingMotor,

	sockets = function(item)

			Base = item:FindFirstChild("BaseTemplate"),

			end

MESH_SLOTS.Harpoon = {
	items = function(ship)
		local stations = ship:FindFirstChild("Stations")
		local harpoons = stations and stations:FindFirstChild("Harpoons")
		local scanRoot = harpoons or ship -- old-tree fallback: root children
		local out = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(scanRoot:GetChildren()) do

	end,
	hideParts = function(item)
		return defaultMeshesOf(MESH_SLOTS.Harpoon.sockets(item))
	end,
}
local MESH_SLOTS_CLOSE = {
	Door = {
		-- TWO SOCKETS, ONE ITEM (2026-09-22). The cabin doorway is a DOUBLE
		-- door: two leaves, 5.76 studs apart, whose RotationParts face OPPOSITE
		-- ways (LookVector dot -0.995). It used to return one item per leaf,
		-- which meant applyMeshSlot mounted IDENTICAL pieces on both — fine for
		-- the stock planked art, which is front/back symmetric, but a themed
		-- leaf then showed its decorated face on one door and its bare back on
		-- the other (DiscoOcto's tentacle, caught in preview).
		--
		-- So the pair is now ONE item (the Doors folder) with the two leaves as
		-- separate sockets, exactly like Window's BasePart + CoverPart. A skin
		-- supplies a LeftDoor piece and a RightDoor piece.
		--
		-- The rig is deliberately NOT renamed: ShipSoundManager resolves the
		-- path string "Doors.Door.RotationPart", so both items keep the name
		-- "Door" and left/right is decided geometrically below.
		items = function(ship)
			local structure = ship:FindFirstChild("Structure")
			local f = (structure and structure:FindFirstChild("Doors"))
				or ship:FindFirstChild("Doors") -- old-tree fallback
			return f and { f } or {}
		end,
		sockets = function(folder)
			-- canonical rig 2026-07-23: RotationPart is the invisible solid
			-- door leaf on the hinge (old Collider); every visual is a
			-- DefaultMesh welded to it. Static side = the hull cabin itself.
			local leaves = {}
			for _, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				local rp = item:FindFirstChild("RotationPart")
				if rp then table.insert(leaves, rp) end
			end
			if #leaves == 0 then return {} end
			if #leaves == 1 then
				-- a one-leaf door: both socket names resolve to it, so a skin
				-- built for the pair still dresses it instead of failing
				return { LeftDoor = leaves[1], RightDoor = leaves[1] }
			end
			-- Which leaf is which must NEVER flip between spawns, so decide it
			-- from geometry rather than child order: project each leaf onto the
			-- hull's RightVector. Falls back to child order if the hull is gone.
			local ship = folder
			while ship and not ship:FindFirstChild("Hull") do ship = ship.Parent end
			local hull = ship and ship:FindFirstChild("Hull")
			if hull and hull:IsA("BasePart") then
				local right = hull.CFrame.RightVector
				table.sort(leaves, function(a, b)
					return a.Position:Dot(right) < b.Position:Dot(right)
				end)
			end
			return { LeftDoor = leaves[1], RightDoor = leaves[2] }
		end,
		-- SPREAD TO THE HINGES (2026-09-22). A themed leaf is usually wider
		-- than the rig's 5.30 — DiscoOcto's is 6.51, carrying its own hinge
		-- barrels — so two of them centred on sockets 5.76 apart OVERLAP in the
		-- middle of the doorway by 0.75 studs.
		--
		-- Each leaf is pushed outward by half its excess width, which restores
		-- the rig's own 0.462 gap. Derived from the mesh at mount time rather
		-- than a constant, so ANY door skin self-corrects and the designer sets
		-- nothing per theme.
		postMount = function(socketName, sockets, mesh)
			local a, b = sockets.LeftDoor, sockets.RightDoor
			local socket = sockets[socketName]
			if not (a and b and socket) or a == b then return end
			local outward = socket.Position - (a.Position + b.Position) / 2
			if outward.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return end
			outward = outward.Unit
			-- oriented extent along the doorway axis, so rotation cannot fool it
			local function extent(p)
				local cf, sz = p.CFrame, p.Size
				return math.abs(outward:Dot(cf.RightVector)) * sz.X
					+ math.abs(outward:Dot(cf.UpVector)) * sz.Y
					+ math.abs(outward:Dot(cf.LookVector)) * sz.Z
			end
			local shift = (extent(mesh) - extent(socket)) / 2
			if shift <= 0 then return end -- a leaf at or under rig width needs none
			mesh.CFrame = mesh.CFrame + outward * shift
			-- mountMesh already welded at the OLD pose; re-seat it or physics
			-- snaps the leaf straight back to the overlap
			local w = mesh:FindFirstChild("AutoWeld")
			if w and w:IsA("Weld") then
				w.C0 = socket.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(mesh.CFrame)
			end
		end,
		hideParts = function(item)
			-- NOTE: must reference MESH_SLOTS.Door (in scope), NOT
			-- MESH_SLOTS_CLOSE — a local is not visible inside its own
			-- initializer, so that resolved to nil at runtime and the
			-- thrown error killed the wiring loop for every later slot
			-- (the 10s waitForSkins stall, 2026-07-24).
			return defaultMeshesOf(MESH_SLOTS.Door.sockets(item))
		end,
	},
}
MESH_SLOTS.Door = MESH_SLOTS_CLOSE.Door
MESH_SLOTS.Window = {
	items = function(ship)
		local structure = ship:FindFirstChild("Structure")
		local windows = structure and structure:FindFirstChild("Windows")
		local out = {}

		-- ride the open/close motor and fly off with the break.

}
-- BELL (2026-09-28: the Shipyard sold bell skins the Arena never wore). The sockets
-- are the three hidden rig parts Base / Rotation / Tounge (the rig's spelling, PR #25).
-- The visible art is a named MeshPart under each (BasePart / RotationPart /
-- TonguePart, on a SkinWeld), and a skin's pieces carry those same names — so the

MESH_SLOTS.Bell = {
	items = function(ship)
		local props = ship:FindFirstChild("Props")
		local bell = (props and props:FindFirstChild("Bell")) or ship:FindFirstChild("Bell", true)
		return bell and { bell } or {}

			local part = item:FindFirstChild(rigName)

		end
		return out
	end,

		for piece, socket in pairs(MESH_SLOTS.Bell.sockets(item)) do
			local art = socket:FindFirstChild(piece)

		end
		return out
	end,
}
MESH_SLOTS.Stove = {
	items = function(ship)
		local props = ship:FindFirstChild("Props")
		local kitchen = props and props:FindFirstChild("Kitchen")
		local stove = (kitchen and kitchen:FindFirstChild("Stove")) or ship:FindFirstChild("Stove", true)
		return stove and { stove } or {}
	end,

	end,

		return defaultMeshesOf(MESH_SLOTS.Stove.sockets(item))
	end,
}

return {
	slots = MESH_SLOTS,
	defaultMeshesOf = defaultMeshesOf,

}
